Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Kilesaṃ [M 4.0001][V 4.0001] dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lobhaṃ paṭicca moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ thīnaṃ (sī. syā.) uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho diṭṭhi uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho māno thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ[V 4.0002], lobhaṃ paṭicca moho māno uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ; dosaṃ paṭicca moho thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, dosaṃ paṭicca moho uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ[T 4.0291]; vicikicchaṃ paṭicca moho uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ; uddhaccaṃ paṭicca moho ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ. (1)

1. Dependent on a defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on greed, there arise delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on greed, there arise delusion, wrong view, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on greed, there arise delusion, conceit, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on greed, there arise delusion, conceit, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on greed, there arise delusion, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on greed, there arise delusion, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on hatred, there arise delusion, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on hatred, there arise delusion, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on doubt, there arise delusion, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing; dependent on restlessness, there arise delusion, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing. (1)

Kilesaṃ [M 4.0002] dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kilesaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a defilement-state, a non-defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on a defilement, associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise. (2)

Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – lobhaṃ paṭicca moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a defilement-state, defilement-states and non-defilement-states arise by way of root condition: dependent on greed, there arise delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, fearlessness of wrongdoing, associated aggregates, and mind-originated matter (cycle). (3)

2. Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

2. Dependent on a non-defilement-state, a non-defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on one non-defilement aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the physical basis; dependent on the physical basis, aggregates; dependent on one great element…. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nokilese khandhe paṭicca kilesā. (2)

Dependent on a non-defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on non-defilement aggregates, defilements arise. (2)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kilesā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a non-defilement-state, defilement-states and non-defilement-states arise by way of root condition: dependent on one non-defilement aggregate, three aggregates, defilements, and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates…. (3)

3. Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lobhañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

3. Dependent on a defilement-state and a non-defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on greed and associated aggregates, there arise delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing (cycle). (1)

Kilesañca [V 4.0003] nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kilese ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… kilese ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 4.0292] rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a defilement-state and a non-defilement-state, a non-defilement-state arises by way of root condition: dependent on one non-defilement aggregate and defilements, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates… dependent on defilements and great elements, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a defilement-state and a non-defilement-state, defilement-states and non-defilement-states arise by way of root condition: dependent on one non-defilement aggregate and greed, there arise three aggregates, delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, fearlessness of wrongdoing, and mind-originated matter… two aggregates… (cycle, abbreviated). (3)

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

5. Kilesaṃ [M 4.0003] dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchaṃ paṭicca moho, uddhaccaṃ paṭicca moho. (1)

5. Dependent on a defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on doubt, delusion arises; dependent on restlessness, delusion arises. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

Dependent on a non-defilement-state, a non-defilement-state arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless non-defilement aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (up to the non-percipient beings). (1)

Nokilesaṃ [V 4.0004] dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on a non-defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt or by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt or by restlessness arises. (2)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vicikicchañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca uddhaccañca paṭicca uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Dependent on a defilement-state and a non-defilement-state, a defilement-state arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and on doubt itself, delusion accompanied by doubt arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by restlessness and on restlessness itself, delusion accompanied by restlessness arises. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayādi

By non-object condition, etc.

6. Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – kilese paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

6. Dependent on a defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-object condition: dependent on defilements, mind-produced materiality arises. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ [T 4.0293] paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nokilese khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

Dependent on a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-object condition: dependent on non-defiled aggregates, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on the aggregates, the physical basis arises (as far as non-percipient beings). (1)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – kilese ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kilese ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a defiled phenomenon and a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-object condition: dependent on defilements and associated aggregates, mind-produced materiality arises; dependent on defilements and the great elements, mind-produced materiality arises. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayā… naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

By non-dominance condition… by non-contiguity condition… by non-immediate contiguity condition… by non-mutuality condition… by non-decisive support condition.

Napurejātapaccayādi

By non-pre-nascence condition, etc.

7. Kilesaṃ [M 4.0004] dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe lobhaṃ paṭicca moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho diṭṭhi uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho māno thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho māno uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ [V 4.0005] anottappaṃ, lobhaṃ paṭicca moho uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ; vicikicchaṃ paṭicca moho uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ; uddhaccaṃ paṭicca moho ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ (arūpe dosamūlakaṃ natthi). (1)

7. Dependent on a defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises by non-pre-nascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on greed, delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on greed, delusion, wrong view, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on greed, delusion, conceit, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on greed, delusion, conceit, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on greed, delusion, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on greed, delusion, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on doubt, delusion, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise; dependent on restlessness, delusion, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise (in the immaterial realm, there is nothing rooted in hatred). (1)

Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe kilese paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, kilese paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (evaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā), napacchājātapaccayā, naāsevanapaccayā.

Dependent on a defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-pre-nascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on defilements, associated aggregates arise; dependent on defilements, mind-produced materiality arises (thus, nine questions should be formulated); by non-post-nascence condition; by non-repetition condition.

Non-Kamma Condition

8. Kilesaṃ [T 4.0294] dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kilese paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

8. Dependent on a defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-kamma condition: dependent on defilements, associated volition arises. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nokilese khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-kamma condition: dependent on non-defiled aggregates, associated volition arises; external… food-originated… temperature-originated…and so on…. (1)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nokileso dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kilese ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1) (Evaṃ sabbe paccayā kātabbā.)

Dependent on a defiled phenomenon and a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by non-kamma condition: dependent on defilements and associated aggregates, associated volition arises. (1) (Thus all conditions should be treated.)

Root Condition

10. Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

10. Dependent on a defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises by root condition… three (similar to the dependent section).

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ paccayā nokilesā khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one non-defiled aggregate, three aggregates arise…and so on…(as far as the internal great elements); dependent on the physical basis, non-defiled aggregates arise. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 4.0295] – nokilese khandhe paccayā kilesā, vatthuṃ paccayā kilesā. (2)

Dependent on a non-defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on non-defiled aggregates, defilements arise; dependent on the physical basis, defilements arise. (2)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā kilesā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā kilesā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-defiled phenomenon, both defiled and non-defiled phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on one non-defiled aggregate, three aggregates, defilements, and mind-produced materiality arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates…and so on…dependent on the physical basis, defilements arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality arises; dependent on the physical basis, defilements and associated aggregates arise. (3)

11. Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lobhañca [V 4.0007] sampayuttake ca khandhe paccayā moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ (cakkaṃ). Lobhañca vatthuñca paccayā kilesā. (1)

11. Dependent on a defiled and a non-defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on greed and the associated aggregates, delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and moral recklessness arise (a cycle). Dependent on greed and the physical basis, defilements arise. (1)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paccayā nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kilesañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… kilese ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kilese ca vatthuñca paccayā nokilesā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a defiled and a non-defiled phenomenon, a non-defiled phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one non-defiled aggregate and a defilement, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates and…and so on…dependent on defilements and the great elements, mind-produced materiality arises; dependent on defilements and the physical basis, the non-defiled aggregates arise. (2)

Kilesañca [M 4.0006] nokilesañca dhammaṃ paccayā kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nokilesaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paccayā tayo khandhā moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ). Lobhañca vatthuñca paccayā moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a defiled and a non-defiled phenomenon, both defiled and non-defiled phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on one non-defiled aggregate and greed, three aggregates, delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, moral recklessness, and mind-produced materiality arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates…and so on…(a cycle). Dependent on greed and the physical basis, delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, moral recklessness, and the associated aggregates arise (a cycle). (3)

(Ārammaṇapaccaye nokilesamūle pañca viññāṇā kātabbā.)

(In the object condition, the five sense-consciousnesses are to be treated as not rooted in defilements.)

Non-Root Condition

13. Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchaṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccaṃ paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

13. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: doubt is a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt; restlessness is a condition for delusion accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Nokilesaṃ [V 4.0008] dhammaṃ paccayā nokileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (yāva asaññasattā) – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā nokilesā khandhā. (1)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a non-defiled phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition (as far as non-percipient beings): the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness...pe...the body-base...pe...the physical base is a condition for rootless non-defiled aggregates. (1)

Nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: the aggregates accompanied by doubt or by restlessness, and the physical base, are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt or by restlessness. (2)

Kilesañca nokilesañca dhammaṃ paccayā kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchañca sampayuttake ca khandhe vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccañca sampayuttake ca khandhe vatthuñca paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Both a defiled and a non-defiled phenomenon are a condition for a defiled phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: doubt, the associated aggregates, and the physical base are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt; restlessness, the associated aggregates, and the physical base are a condition for delusion accompanied by restlessness (in brief). (1)

14. By non-root condition: four; by non-object condition: three; by non-dominance condition: nine...pe...by non-kamma condition: three; by non-result condition: nine; by non-nutriment condition: one...pe...by non-(non-disappearance) condition: three.

15. Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 4.0297] – lobhaṃ saṃsaṭṭho moho diṭṭhi thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ. (Cakkaṃ. Evaṃ nava pañhā kātabbā.)

15. A defiled phenomenon associated with a defiled phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with greed are delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing. (The cycle. Thus nine questions should be done.)

Hetuyā [V 4.0009] nava, ārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate nava.

By root condition: nine; by object condition: nine (in all cases, nine); by result condition: one...pe...by non-disappearance condition: nine.

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

Kilesaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kileso dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (evaṃ nahetupañhā cattāri kātabbā.)

A defiled phenomenon associated with a defiled phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition. (Thus, four non-root questions should be done.)

Nahetuyā cattāri, naadhipatiyā nava, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte nava.

By non-root condition: four; by non-dominance condition: nine; by non-pre-arisen condition: nine; by non-post-arisen condition: nine; by non-repetition condition: nine; by non-kamma condition: three; by non-result condition: nine; by non-jhāna condition: one; by non-path condition: one; by non-dissociation condition: nine.

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

16. Kileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kilesā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ kilesānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ [M 4.0008] pucchitabbaṃ.) Kilesā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ.) Kilesā [V 4.0010] hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kilesānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

16. A defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiling phenomenon by way of root condition—defilements that are roots are a condition for associated defilements by way of root condition. (The root should be inquired into.) Defilements that are roots are a condition for associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition. (The root should be inquired into.) Defilements that are roots are a condition for associated aggregates, defilements, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition. (3)

Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nokilesā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a non-defiled phenomenon by way of root condition – non-defiled roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

17. Kileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [T 4.0298] – kilese ārabbha kilesā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ.) Kilese ārabbha nokilesā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ.) Kilese ārabbha kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

17. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition—with reference to defilements, defilements arise. (The root should be questioned.) With reference to defilements, non-defiled aggregates arise. (The root should be questioned.) With reference to defilements, defilements and associated aggregates arise. (3)

18. Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

18. A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a non-defiled phenomenon by way of object condition—giving a gift... observing virtue... undertaking the Uposatha observance... past good deeds... having emerged from jhāna, one reviews, savors, and delights in that jhāna; with reference to that, lust... wrong view... doubt... restlessness... grief arises. The noble ones, having emerged from the path... this is a condition for the fruit, for adverting, by way of object condition. One regards the eye... the physical basis... the non-defiled aggregates as impermanent... and grief arises. With the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound... this is a condition for the knowledge of the future, for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition—one gives a gift... having emerged from jhāna, one savors and delights in that jhāna; with reference to that, lust... wrong view... doubt... restlessness arises. When one has fallen away from jhāna, grief arises for one who is remorseful. One savors and delights in the eye... the physical basis... the non-defiled aggregates; with reference to that, lust... grief arises. (2)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa ca nokilesassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for both defiled and non-defiled phenomena by way of object condition—one gives a gift... having emerged from jhāna... one savors and delights in the eye... the physical basis... the non-defiled aggregates; with reference to that, defilements and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Kileso [T 4.0299][M 4.0009][V 4.0011] ca nokileso ca dhammā kilesassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

Both defiled and non-defiled phenomena are a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition... three.

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

19. Kileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – kilese garuṃ katvā kilesā uppajjanti… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva). (3)

19. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: having esteemed the defilements, defilements arise... three (by way of object-dominance only). (3)

Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti…pe… phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nokilesādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a non-defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift... observed virtue... undertaken the Uposatha observance, one esteems it, reviews it, savors, and delights in it; by esteeming it, lust arises, wrong view arises. Formerly... having emerged from the jhānas... from the noble paths, the noble ones esteem the path and review it... this is a condition for the fruit by way of dominance condition. The eye... the physical basis... having esteemed the non-defiled aggregates, one savors and delights in them; by esteeming them, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a non-defiled dominant factor is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nokilesādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ kilesānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having esteemed a gift... jhāna... the eye... the physical basis, the non-defiled aggregates, one savors and delights in them; by esteeming them, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a non-defiled dominant factor is a condition for associated defilements by way of dominance condition. (2)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa ca nokilesassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati [T 4.0300] – dānaṃ…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nokilese khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – nokilesādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kilesānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-defiled phenomenon is a condition for both defiled and non-defiled phenomena by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having esteemed a gift... jhāna... the eye... the physical basis, the non-defiled aggregates, one savors and delights in them; by esteeming them, defilements and associated aggregates arise. Conascence-dominance: a non-defiled dominant factor is a condition for associated aggregates, for defilements, and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

Kileso [V 4.0012] ca nokileso ca dhammā kilesassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva). (3)

Both defiled and non-defiled phenomena are a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition... three (by way of object-dominance only). (3)

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

20. Kileso [M 4.0010] dhammo kilesassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kilesā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā kilesā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nokilesānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; kilesā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā kilesā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

20. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of proximity condition: preceding defilements are a condition for subsequent defilements by way of proximity condition. (The root should be supplied.) Preceding defilements are a condition for subsequent non-defiled aggregates by way of proximity condition; defilements are a condition for emergence by way of proximity condition. (The root should be supplied.) Preceding defilements are a condition for subsequent defilements and associated aggregates by way of proximity condition. (3)

21. Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nokilesā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nokilesānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā nokilesā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā kilesānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā nokilesā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ [T 4.0301] anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

21. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of the immediately proximate condition: preceding undefiled aggregates are conditions for subsequent undefiled aggregates by way of the immediately proximate condition… up to the fruition attainment by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root is to be supplied.) Preceding undefiled aggregates are conditions for subsequent defilements by way of the immediately proximate condition; adverting is a condition for defilements by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root is to be supplied.) Preceding undefiled aggregates are conditions for subsequent defilements and their associated aggregates by way of the immediately proximate condition; adverting is a condition for defilements and their associated aggregates by way of the immediately proximate condition. (3)

22. Kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā kilesassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nokilesānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

22. Defiled and undefiled phenomena are conditions for a defiled phenomenon by way of the immediately proximate condition: preceding defilements and their associated aggregates are conditions for subsequent defilements by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root is to be supplied.) Preceding defilements and their associated aggregates are conditions for subsequent undefiled aggregates by way of the immediately proximate condition; defilements and their associated aggregates are conditions for emergence by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root is to be supplied.) Preceding defilements and their associated aggregates are conditions for subsequent defilements and their associated aggregates by way of the immediately proximate condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena [V 4.0013] paccayo, sahajātapaccayena paccayo, aññamaññapaccayena paccayo, nissayapaccayena paccayo.

It is a condition by way of contiguity, a condition by way of co-nascence, a condition by way of reciprocity, a condition by way of support.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

23. Kileso [M 4.0011] dhammo kilesassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kilesā kilesānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

23. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object-decisive support, contiguity-decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: defilements are a condition for defilements by way of the decisive support condition… Three.

24. Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object-decisive support, contiguity-decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift… indulges in conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue… wisdom… passion… aversion… delusion… conceit… a view… aspiration… bodily pleasure… a dwelling, one gives a gift… splits the Saṅgha; faith… a dwelling is a condition for faith… for the attainment of fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Nokileso [T 4.0302] dhammo kilesassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ kilesānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object-decisive support, contiguity-decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one indulges in conceit… grasps a view; relying on virtue… a dwelling, one kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha; faith… a dwelling is a condition for defilements by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa ca nokilesassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and an undefiled phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object-decisive support, contiguity-decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one indulges in conceit… grasps a view; relying on virtue… a dwelling, one kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha; faith… a dwelling is a condition for defilements and their associated aggregates by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Kileso [V 4.0014] ca nokileso ca dhammā kilesassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

Defiled and undefiled phenomena are a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition… Three.

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

25. Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā [M 4.0012] rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nokilesānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… a physical basis is regarded as impermanent… and sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical basis is a condition for undefiled aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati[T 4.0303], taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu kilesānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one enjoys and delights in the eye… a physical basis; taking that as object, passion… and sorrow arise. Base pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for defilements by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nokileso dhammo kilesassa ca nokilesassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu kilesānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and an undefiled phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one enjoys and delights in the eye… a physical basis; taking that as object, defilements and their associated aggregates arise. Base pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for defilements and their associated aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

26. Kileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

26. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Nokileso dhammo nokilesassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Co-nascent: greed and the associated aggregates are a condition for delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and lack of moral dread by way of presence-condition (a cycle). Co-nascent: greed and the base are a condition for delusion, wrong view, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, and lack of moral dread by way of presence-condition (a cycle). (1)

Kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā nokilesassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nokileso eko khandho ca kileso ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajātā – kilesā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – kilesā ca vatthu ca nokilesānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kilesā ca sampayuttakā [T 4.0306] khandhā ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kilesā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Defiled and non-defiled phenomena are a condition for a non-defiled phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: one non-defiled aggregate and a defilement are a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence-condition… two aggregates and so on…. Co-nascent: defilements and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence-condition. Co-nascent: defilements and the base are a condition for non-defiled aggregates by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: defilements and associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: defilements, associated aggregates, and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: defilements, associated aggregates, and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence-condition. (2)

Kileso ca nokileso ca dhammā kilesassa ca nokilesassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto [M 4.0015] – nokileso eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ mohassa ca, diṭṭhiyā, thinassa, uddhaccassa, ahirikassa, anottappassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – lobho ca vatthu ca mohassa, diṭṭhiyā, thinassa, uddhaccassa, ahirikassa, anottappassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (3)

Defiled and undefiled phenomena are conditions for defiled and undefiled phenomena by way of presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising: one undefiled aggregate and greed are conditions for three aggregates and mind-originated materiality, and for delusion, wrong view, sloth, agitation, shamelessness, and lack of conscience by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates and…pe…. Co-arising: greed and the base are conditions for delusion, wrong view, sloth, agitation, shamelessness, and lack of conscience, and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition (a cycle). (3)

Root Condition

44. Saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ [M 4.0019] dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisaṃ).

44. A defiled phenomenon arises conditioned by a defiled phenomenon by way of root condition… three (cases, similar to the Paṭicca section).

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā. (1)

An undefiled phenomenon arises conditioned by an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition—conditioned by one undefiled aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise... two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking... (up to the internal great elements); conditioned by the base, the undefiled aggregates arise. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho [T 4.0311] dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā. (2)

A defiled phenomenon arises conditioned by an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition—conditioned by the base, defiled aggregates arise. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ [V 4.0023] dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

Both defiled and undefiled phenomena arise conditioned by an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition—conditioned by the base, defiled aggregates arise; conditioned by the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (3)

45. Saṃkiliṭṭhañca asaṃkiliṭṭhañca dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

45. A defiled phenomenon arises conditioned by both defiled and undefiled phenomena by way of root condition—conditioned by one defiled aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise... two aggregates... (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhañca asaṃkiliṭṭhañca dhammaṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Conditioned by a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon, an undefiled phenomenon arises by way of root condition: conditioned by defiled aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhañca asaṃkiliṭṭhañca dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… saṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Conditioned by a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon, defiled and undefiled phenomena arise by way of root condition: conditioned by one defiled aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise… and by two aggregates…; conditioned by defiled aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises (in brief). (3)

46. Nine by root condition, four by object condition, nine by dominance condition, four by contiguity condition, four by immediate proximity condition, nine by co-nascence condition, four by reciprocity condition, nine by dependence condition, four by decisive support condition, four by pre-nascence condition, four by repetition condition, nine by kamma condition, one by result condition, nine by nutriment condition, nine by faculty condition… four by disappearance condition, nine by non-disappearance condition.

Not by Root Condition

47. Saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ [V 4.0024] dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato [T 4.0312] uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

47. Conditioned by a defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā) cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā asaṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā. (1)

Conditioned by an undefiled phenomenon, an undefiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: rootless undefiled… (as far as non-percipient beings); conditioned by the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… conditioned by the body-base, body-consciousness arises; conditioned by the base, rootless undefiled aggregates arise. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Conditioned by an undefiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: conditioned by the base, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhañca asaṃkiliṭṭhañca dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Conditioned by a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and by the base, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

49. Saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ [M 4.0021][V 4.0025] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe [T 4.0313] …pe…. (1)

49. Associated with a defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with one defiled aggregate, three aggregates arise… and two aggregates… (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Associated with an undefiled phenomenon, an undefiled phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with one undefiled aggregate, three aggregates arise… and two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā dve (sabbattha dve), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate dve.

By way of root condition, two; by way of object condition, two; by way of dominance condition, two (in all cases, two); by way of result condition, one… by way of non-disappearance condition, two.

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

50. Saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

50. Associated with a defiled phenomenon, a defiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Associated with an undefiled phenomenon, an undefiled phenomenon arises not by way of root condition: associated with one rootless undefiled aggregate, three aggregates arise… and two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (1)

Nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā dve, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve.

Not by way of root condition, two; not by way of dominance condition, two; not by way of pre-nascence condition, two; not by way of post-nascence condition, two; not by way of repetition condition, two; not by way of kamma condition, two; not by way of result condition, two; not by way of jhāna condition, one; not by way of path condition, one; not by way of dissociation condition, two.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

51. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

51. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of root condition: defiled roots are a condition for their associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho [M 4.0022] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo [T 4.0314] – saṃkiliṭṭhā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition: defiled roots are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for both a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition: defiled roots are a condition for their associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of root condition: undefiled roots are a condition for their associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking...etc.... (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

52. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – rāgaṃ assādeti [V 4.0027] abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; vicikicchā…pe… uddhacca…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ assādeti…pe… (kusalattikasadisaṃ); vicikicchaṃ ārabbha…pe… uddhaccaṃ ārabbha…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. (1)

52. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition: one savors and delights in lust; taking that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises; doubt...etc....restlessness...etc....distress arises; one savors wrong view...etc.... (similar to the wholesome triad); taking doubt as object...etc....taking restlessness as object...etc....distress arises; wrong view...etc....doubt...etc....restlessness arises. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe…pe… saṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena saṃkiliṭṭhacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti; saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of object condition: noble ones reflect on abandoned defilements, on suppressed defilements...etc....on previously practiced defilements...etc....they discern the defiled aggregates as impermanent...etc....with knowledge of others' minds, they know the mind of one endowed with a defiled mind; the defiled aggregates are a condition for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollection of past lives, for knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (2)

53. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā [T 4.0315] vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti…pe… āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

53. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of object condition: generosity...etc....virtue...etc....the Uposatha observance...etc....previously...etc....having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path...etc....it is a condition for adverting by way of object condition; one discerns the eye...etc....the base...etc....the undefiled aggregates as impermanent...etc....one sees forms with the divine eye...etc....it is a condition for knowledge of the future and for adverting by way of object condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe [M 4.0023] assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition: generosity...etc....virtue...etc....having emerged from jhāna...etc....one savors and delights in the eye...etc....the base...etc....the undefiled aggregates; taking that as object, lust...etc....distress arises. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

54. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti [V 4.0028] abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

54. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Having made lust a dominant factor, one savors and delights in it; having made that a dominant factor, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having made wrong view a dominant factor, one savors and delights in it; having made that a dominant factor, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: A defiled dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: A defiled dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for both a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: A defiled dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

55. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa [T 4.0316] adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti…pe… nibbānaṃ phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – asaṃkiliṭṭhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

55. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Generosity...etc....virtue...etc....the Uposatha observance...etc....previously...etc....having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, making it a dominant factor; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, making it a dominant factor...etc....Nibbāna is a condition for fruition by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: An undefiled dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: Generosity...etc....virtue...etc....the Uposatha observance...etc....previously...etc....having emerged from jhāna...etc....one savors and delights in the eye...etc....the base...etc....the undefiled aggregates, making them a dominant factor; having made that a dominant factor, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

56. Saṃkiliṭṭho [M 4.0024] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

56. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of contiguity condition—preceding defiled aggregates are a condition for succeeding defiled aggregates by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho [V 4.0029] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of the immediately contiguous condition – the defiled aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (2)

57. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā asaṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

57. An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of the immediately contiguous condition—the preceding undefiled aggregates are a condition for the succeeding undefiled aggregates... for the attainment of fruition, by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā [T 4.0317] saṃkiliṭṭhānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of the immediately contiguous condition—adverting is a condition for the defiled aggregates by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pañca… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… dve… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta.

By way of immediately contiguous condition… four… by way of co-nascence condition… five… by way of mutuality condition… two… by way of support condition… seven.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

58. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, dosaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, rāgo…pe… patthanā rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

58. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... Natural decisive support: relying on lust, one kills a living being... splits the Saṅgha; relying on hatred... relying on aspiration, one kills a living being... splits the Saṅgha; lust... aspiration is a condition for lust... for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, dosaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, rāgo…pe… patthanā saddhāya…pe… paññāya kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... Natural decisive support: relying on lust, one gives a gift... develops an attainment; relying on hatred... relying on aspiration, one gives a gift... develops an attainment; lust... aspiration is a condition for faith... for wisdom, for bodily pleasure... for bodily pain... for the path, for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (2)

59. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[V 4.0030], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ [M 4.0025] uppādeti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ [T 4.0318] uppādeti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

59. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith, one gives a gift… develops an attainment; relying on virtue… wisdom, bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one gives a gift… develops an attainment; faith… lodging is a condition for faith… for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith, one generates conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha; faith… lodging is a condition for lust… for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

60. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

60. An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence, base-prenascence (in brief). An undefiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence, base-prenascence (in brief). (2)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Postnascence and Repetition Conditions

61. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). …Āsevanapaccayena paccayo… dve.

61. A defiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of postnascence condition (in brief). An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of postnascence condition (in brief). …By way of repetition condition… two.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

62. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

62. A defiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of kamma condition: defiled volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho [V 4.0031] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – saṃkiliṭṭhā [T 4.0319] cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Saṃkiliṭṭhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of kamma condition: co-nascence and different-moment. Co-nascence: defiled volition is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: defiled volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-generated matter by way of kamma condition. (The root is to be done.) Defiled volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho [M 4.0026] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – asaṃkiliṭṭhā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of kamma condition: co-nascence and different-moment. Co-nascence: undefiled volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. Different-moment: undefiled volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-generated matter by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, etc.

63. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

63. An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of result condition… one.

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo.

A defiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

64. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

64. A defiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, postnascence (in brief). (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of dissociation condition: conascence, prenascence, and postnascence (in brief). (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu saṃkiliṭṭhānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the base is a condition for the defiled aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, etc.

65. Saṃkiliṭṭho [V 4.0032] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo [T 4.0320]… ekaṃ (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ). Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

65. A defiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of presence condition … one (like the Dependent Origination Section). A defiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of presence condition: conascence, postnascence (in brief). A defiled state is a condition for both a defiled and an undefiled state by way of presence condition (like the Dependent Origination Section). (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

An undefiled state is a condition for an undefiled state by way of presence condition: conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief). An undefiled state is a condition for a defiled state by way of presence condition: prenascence (in brief). (2)

66. Saṃkiliṭṭho [M 4.0027] ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – saṃkiliṭṭho eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

66. Defiled and undefiled states are a condition for a defiled state by way of presence condition: conascence, prenascence. Conascence: one defiled aggregate and the base are a condition for the three other aggregates by way of presence condition …pe… two aggregates and the base …pe… (in brief). (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saṃkiliṭṭhā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Defiled and undefiled states are a condition for an undefiled state by way of presence condition: conascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascence: the defiled aggregates and the great primary elements are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition. Postnascence: the defiled aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Postnascence: the defiled aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-generated matter by way of presence condition. (2)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

Is a condition by way of absence condition … by way of disappearance condition … by way of non-disappearance condition.

67. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare [T 4.0321] cattāri, samanantare [V 4.0033] cattāri, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye satta, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, pacchājāte dve, āsevane dve, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte dve, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate satta.

By way of root condition—four; by way of object condition—four; by way of dominance condition—five; by way of proximity condition—four; by way of immediacy condition—four; by way of conascence condition—five; by way of reciprocity condition—two; by way of dependence condition—seven; by way of strong dependence condition—four; by way of prenascence condition—two; by way of postnascence condition—two; by way of repetition condition—two; by way of kamma condition—four; by way of result condition—one; by way of nutriment condition—four; by way of faculty condition—four; by way of jhāna condition—four; by way of path condition—four; by way of association condition—two; by way of dissociation condition—three; by way of presence condition—seven; by way of absence condition—four; by way of disappearance condition—four; by way of non-disappearance condition—seven.

68. Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

68. A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of postnascence condition... by way of kamma condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭho [M 4.0028] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon and an undefiled phenomenon by way of conascence condition. (3)

69. Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of prenascence condition... by way of postnascence condition... by way of kamma condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled phenomenon is a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭho ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ… purejātaṃ[T 4.0322]. (1)

Defiled and undefiled phenomena are a condition for a defiled phenomenon by way of conascence... prenascence. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭho [V 4.0034] ca asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ… pacchājātaṃ… āhāraṃ… indriyaṃ. (2)

Defiled and undefiled phenomena are a condition for an undefiled phenomenon by way of conascence... postnascence... nutriment... faculty. (2)

70. Nahetuyā satta, naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, nasahajāte pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, nanissaye pañca, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte satta…pe… namagge satta, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte cattāri, noatthiyā cattāri, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta, noavigate cattāri.

70. Not by root condition—seven; not by object condition—seven; not by dominance condition—seven; not by proximity condition—seven; not by immediacy condition—seven; not by conascence condition—five; not by reciprocity condition—five; not by dependence condition—five; not by strong dependence condition—seven; not by prenascence condition—six; not by postnascence condition—seven…pe… not by path condition—seven; not by association condition—five; not by dissociation condition—four; not by presence condition—four; not by absence condition—seven; not by disappearance condition—seven; not by non-disappearance condition—four.

71. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe cattāri, naadhipatiyā cattāri, naanantare cattāri, nasamanantare cattāri, naaññamaññe dve, naupanissaye cattāri…pe… nasampayutte dve, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā cattāri, novigate cattāri.

71. By root condition, not by object condition—four; not by dominance condition—four; not by proximity condition—four; not by immediacy condition—four; not by reciprocity condition—two; not by strong dependence condition—four…pe… not by association condition—two; not by dissociation condition—two; not by absence condition—four; not by disappearance condition—four.

72. Nahetupaccayā [M 4.0029] ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā pañca (anulomamātikā)…pe… avigate satta.

72. Not by root condition, by object condition—four; by dominance condition—five (Positive Matrix)…pe… by non-disappearance condition—seven.
