1. The Chapter on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

47. Dassanena [T 4.0356][V 4.0069] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

47. Depending on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: depending on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Depending on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: depending on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Depending on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of root condition: depending on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

48. Nadassanena [M 4.0058] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā). (1)

48. Depending on a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: depending on one aggregate that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… depending on delusion accompanied by doubt, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (up to the internal great elements). (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Depending on a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: depending on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nadassanena [V 4.0070] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko [T 4.0357] ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Depending on a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of root condition: depending on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

49. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

49. Depending on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state that is not one with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: depending on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and on delusion, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a cause not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a cause not to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: dependent on aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a cause not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a cause not to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on…. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

50. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

50. Dependent on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate with a cause to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on…. (1)

Dassanena [M 4.0059] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a cause not to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition: dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt arises. (2)

57. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition. Three.

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ [T 4.0360] dhammaṃ paccayā nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ paccayā nadassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā. (1)

A state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise… and so on for two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… up to the internal great elements. Dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with roots not to be abandoned by seeing arise. (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing arise. Dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of root condition. Dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing arise. Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated form arises. Dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates and mind-originated form arise. (3)

58. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

58. Dependent on both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on for two aggregates… Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on for two aggregates… (1)

Dassanena [V 4.0074] pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[T 4.0361], vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion, mind-originated form arises. (2)

Dassanena [M 4.0062] pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

Dependent on both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on for two aggregates… Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise… and so on for two aggregates… (3)

59. Dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition… three (similar to the dependent origination section).

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nadassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena [T 4.0362] pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca. Dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition: one aggregate with a root not to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates… and so on for two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the physical base conditions the aggregates with roots not to be abandoned by seeing; the physical base conditions delusion accompanied by doubt. Dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition: the physical base conditions the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing; delusion accompanied by doubt conditions the associated aggregates. Dependent on a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing, both a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root not to be abandoned by seeing arise by way of object condition: the physical base conditions the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion. Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Associated with a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision, a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of object condition: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate with a root not to be abandoned by vision…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Nadassanena [V 4.0078] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (2)

Associated with a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision, a state with a root to be abandoned by vision arises by way of object condition (similar to the Dependent Section). (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nadassanena pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā (paṭiccasadisaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Associated with a state with a root to be abandoned by vision and a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision, a state with a root to be abandoned by vision arises by way of object condition (similar to the Dependent Section, in brief). (1)

66. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā dve, anantare cha (sabbattha cha), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate cha.

66. By way of root, four; by way of object, six; by way of dominance, two; by way of contiguity, six (six in all cases); by way of result, one…pe… by way of non-disappearance, six.

Anulomaṃ.

Positive

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

67. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nadassanena pahātabbahetuko [T 4.0365] dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

67. Associated with a state with a root to be abandoned by vision, a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of non-root condition: doubt-accompanied delusion is associated with the doubt-accompanied aggregates. (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Associated with a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision, a state with a root not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of non-root condition: three aggregates are associated with one rootless aggregate not to be abandoned by vision…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…pe… restlessness-accompanied delusion is associated with the restlessness-accompanied aggregates. (1)

Nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte cha.

By way of non-root, two; by way of non-dominance, six; by way of non-prenascence, six; by way of non-postnascence, six; by way of non-repetition, six; by way of non-kamma, four; by way of non-result, six; by way of non-jhāna, one; by way of non-path, one; by way of non-dissociation, six.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative

Hetudukaṃ

Root Dyad

Hetupaccayā [M 4.0066][V 4.0079] naadhipatiyā cattāri, napurejāte cattāri…pe… navippayutte cattāri.

By way of root condition: by way of non-dominance, four; by way of non-prenascence, four…pe… by way of non-dissociation, four.

Nahetudukaṃ

Non-Root Dyad

Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe dve, anantare dve…pe… vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate dve.

In non-root condition: in object, two; in contiguity, two…pe… in result, one…pe… in non-disappearance, two.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

68. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbahetukā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetukā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetukā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 4.0366] cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

68. A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision by way of root condition. Roots to be abandoned by vision are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. (The base text should be supplied.) Roots to be abandoned by vision are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (The base text should be supplied.) Roots to be abandoned by vision are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

69 . Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nadassanena pahātabbahetukā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [V 4.0080] rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo, vicikicchāsahagato moho cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

69. A state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision by way of root condition. Roots not to be abandoned by vision are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; delusion accompanied by uncertainty is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (The base text should be supplied.) Delusion accompanied by uncertainty is a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. (The base text should be supplied.) Delusion accompanied by uncertainty is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

70. Dassanena [M 4.0067] pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ārabbha dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ārabbha nadassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

70. A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision by way of object condition: taking as object aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arise. (The base text should be supplied.) Taking as object aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, aggregates rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision and delusion arise. (The base text should be supplied.) Taking as object aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion arise. (3)

71. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni [T 4.0367] …pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti…pe… ariyā nadassanena pahātabbahetuke pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mohañca aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya, mohassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.

71. A state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision by way of object condition: having given a gift…pe… undertaken the moral precepts…pe… performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it, savors it, rejoices in it; taking that as object, greed rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision arises, agitation arises, displeasure rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision arises; previously well-practiced deeds…pe… having emerged from jhāna…pe… noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect on the path…pe… noble ones reflect on the defilements rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision that have been abandoned, on the defilements that have been suppressed…pe… they know the defilements previously accumulated; the eye…pe… the physical basis… one sees with insight the aggregates rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision and delusion as impermanent…pe… one savors it, rejoices in it; taking that as object, greed rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision arises, agitation arises, displeasure rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision arises; with the divine eye one sees a form…pe… is a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of the future, for adverting, and for delusion.

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mohañca assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbahetuko [V 4.0081] rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati.

A state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision by way of object condition: a gift…pe… jhāna…pe… the eye…pe… the physical basis… one savors and rejoices in the aggregates rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision and delusion; taking that as object, greed rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arises, wrong view…pe… uncertainty…pe… displeasure rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arises.

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision and for a state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision by way of object condition: the eye…pe… the physical basis… taking as object the aggregates rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision and delusion, aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion arise. (3)

72. Dassanena [M 4.0068] pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – vicikicchāsahagate [T 4.0368] khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha nadassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

72. A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision and a state rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision are a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision by way of object condition: taking as object aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion, aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arise. (The base text should be supplied.) Taking as object aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion, aggregates rooted in what is not to be abandoned by vision and delusion arise. (The base text should be supplied.) Taking as object aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion, aggregates accompanied by uncertainty and delusion arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

73. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – dassanena pahātabbahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having given prominence to aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, aggregates rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arise. Conascence-dominance: a dominant factor rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision is a condition for associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – dassanena pahātabbahetukādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing. Conascent Dominance: The dominance of a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for mind-originated matter. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa [V 4.0082] ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – dassanena pahātabbahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and for a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing. Conascent Dominance: The dominance of a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter. (3)

74. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā [T 4.0369] taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… phalassa [M 4.0069] adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nadassanena pahātabbahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing: Object Dominance, Conascent Dominance. Object Dominance: Having given a gift… observed virtue… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it, making it a dominant factor, savors it, and rejoices in it. Making it a dominant factor, greed whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing arises. Previously well-practiced deeds… having emerged from the jhānas… having emerged from the noble paths, one reflects on the path, making it a dominant factor… it is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for the fruit. The eye… the base—one savors and rejoices in the aggregates whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing, making them a dominant factor. Making them a dominant factor, greed whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing arises. Conascent Dominance: The dominance of a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter. (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing. Object Dominance: Having given a gift… observed virtue… undertaken the Uposatha observance… jhāna… the eye… the base—one savors and rejoices in the aggregates whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing, making them a dominant factor. Making them a dominant factor, greed whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. (2)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

75. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ dassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ[T 4.0370].) Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

75. A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of Contiguity Condition—the preceding aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for the succeeding aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of Contiguity Condition. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by doubt are a condition for the succeeding delusion accompanied by doubt by way of Contiguity Condition; aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for emergence by way of Contiguity Condition. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by doubt are a condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion by way of Contiguity Condition. (3)

76. Nadassanena [V 4.0083] pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vicikicchāsahagato moho pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā nadassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimo purimo vicikicchāsahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā dassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimo purimo vicikicchāsahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ [M 4.0070] vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

76. A state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for a state whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing—the preceding delusion accompanied by doubt is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding delusion accompanied by doubt; the preceding aggregates whose root is not to be abandoned by seeing… are a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of Contiguity Condition. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding delusion accompanied by doubt is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by doubt; adverting is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding delusion accompanied by doubt is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion; adverting is a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion. (3)

77. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ [T 4.0371] vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

77. States with roots to be abandoned by seeing and with roots not to be abandoned by seeing are a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing—the preceding aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by doubt. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding delusion accompanied by doubt; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for emergence. (The root is to be elaborated.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition by way of Contiguity Condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

Condition by way of Immediacy… nine. Condition by way of Co-nascence… nine. Condition by way of Mutuality… six. Condition by way of Dependence… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

78. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā dassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Avasesesu dvīsu anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo[V 4.0084].) (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā nadassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

78. A state with a cause to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition—object-decisive support, proximity-decisive support, natural-decisive support... Natural decisive support: aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by vision are a condition for aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition. (In the remaining two, proximity-decisive support and natural-decisive support.) (The root is to be made.) Aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by vision are a condition for aggregates with a cause not to be abandoned by vision and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (The root is to be made.) Aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by vision are a condition for aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (3)

79. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti mānaṃ jappeti; sīlaṃ [M 4.0071] …pe… paññaṃ… nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa [T 4.0372] rāgassa…pe… patthanāya phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

79. A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition—object-decisive support, proximity-decisive support, natural-decisive support... Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift... attains meditative absorption, generates conceit. Relying on morality... wisdom... lust with a cause not to be abandoned by vision... hatred... delusion... conceit... longing... bodily pleasure... bodily pain... climate... food... lodging, one gives a gift... attains meditative absorption. Faith... lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for faith... wisdom, for lust with a cause not to be abandoned by vision... longing, and for the attainment of fruition. (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ dassanena pahātabbahetukassa rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition—object-decisive support, proximity-decisive support, natural-decisive support... Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one adopts a wrong view. Relying on morality... wisdom... lust with a cause not to be abandoned by vision... hatred... delusion... conceit... longing... bodily pleasure... bodily pain... climate... food... lodging, one kills living beings... splits the Sangha. Faith... lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for lust with a cause to be abandoned by vision... for hatred... for delusion... for wrong view... for longing. (2)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhā…pe… paññā, nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo… doso… moho… māno… patthanā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision and for a state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition—proximity-decisive support, natural-decisive support... Natural decisive support: faith... wisdom, lust with a cause not to be abandoned by vision... hatred... delusion... conceit... longing... bodily pleasure... lodging, are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (3)

80. Dassanena [V 4.0085] pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca dassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho [T 4.0373] ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

80. Both a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision and a state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision are a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition—proximity-decisive support, natural-decisive support... Natural decisive support: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition for the aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of decisive support condition. (The root is to be made.) The aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition for the aggregates with a cause not to be abandoned by vision and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (The root is to be made.) The aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by doubt and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

81. Nadassanena [M 4.0072] pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha nadassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena…pe…. (Saṃkhittaṃ. Vatthupurejātaṃ saṃkhittaṃ.) (1)

81. A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one discerns the eye... the base as impermanent..., savors and delights in it; taking that as object, lust with a cause not to be abandoned by vision arises, restlessness arises, grief with a cause not to be abandoned by vision arises; by means of the divine [eye]... (Abbreviated. Base pre-nascence is abbreviated.) (1)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbahetuko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. (Vatthupurejātaṃ saṃkhittaṃ.) (2)

A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye... the base; taking that as object, lust with a cause to be abandoned by vision arises, wrong view... doubt... grief with a cause to be abandoned by vision arises. (Base pre-nascence is abbreviated.) (2)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (Vatthupurejātaṃ saṃkhittaṃ.) (3)

A state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state with a cause to be abandoned by vision and for a state with a cause not to be abandoned by vision by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: taking the eye... the base as object, the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion arise. (Base pre-nascence is abbreviated.) (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

82. Dassanena [T 4.0374][V 4.0086] pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo.

82. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the post-nascence condition (abbreviated). A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the post-nascence condition (abbreviated). A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing are conditions for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the post-nascence condition (abbreviated)... by way of the repetition condition.

Kammapaccayādi

The kamma condition, and so on.

83. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā [M 4.0073] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

83. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of the kamma condition: volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. (The root should be applied.) Co-nascence, non-momentary. Co-nascence: volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of the kamma condition. Non-momentary: volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for the resultant aggregates and kamma-produced materiality by way of the kamma condition. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the kamma condition: volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced materiality by way of the kamma condition. (3)

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nadassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nadassanena [T 4.0375] pahātabbahetukā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the kamma condition: Co-nascence, non-momentary. Co-nascence: volition whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced materiality by way of the kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Non-momentary: volition whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for the resultant aggregates and kamma-produced materiality by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha… vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

By way of the result condition... by way of the nutriment condition... by way of the faculty condition... by way of the jhana condition... by way of the path condition... by way of the association condition: six; by way of the dissociation condition: five.

Atthipaccayādi

The presence condition, and so on.

84. Dassanena [V 4.0087] pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

84. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of the presence condition: three.

Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (abbreviated). A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence (abbreviated). A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing is a condition for both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence (abbreviated). (3)

85. Dassanena [M 4.0074] pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – dassanena pahātabbahetuko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… vicikicchāsahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa [T 4.0376] dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

85. Both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing are conditions for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and the base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of the presence condition... two aggregates... one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion are conditions for the three aggregates by way of the presence condition... two aggregates... Both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing are conditions for a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (abbreviated). Both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing are conditions for both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence (abbreviated). (3)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By way of the absence condition... by way of the disappearance condition... by way of the non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

86. Hetuyā [V 4.0088] cha, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

86. In the root condition: six; in the object condition: nine; in the dominance condition: five; in the contiguity condition: nine; in the immediate contiguity condition: nine; in the co-nascence condition: nine; in the mutuality condition: six; in the support condition: nine; in the decisive support condition: nine; in the pre-nascence condition: three; in the post-nascence condition: three; in the repetition condition: nine; in the kamma condition: four; in the result condition: one; in the nutriment condition: four; in the faculty condition: four; in the jhana condition: four; in the path condition: four; in the association condition: six; in the dissociation condition: five; in the presence condition: nine; in the absence condition: nine; in the disappearance condition: nine; in the non-disappearance condition: nine.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Summary of Negative Relations

87. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena [M 4.0075] paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa [T 4.0377] ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

87. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition… by way of the post-nascence condition… by way of the kamma condition. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

88. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. Nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

88. A phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition… by way of the pre-nascence condition… by way of the post-nascence condition… by way of the kamma condition… by way of the nutriment condition… by way of the faculty condition. A phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition… by way of the pre-nascence condition. A phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition… by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

89. Dassanena [V 4.0089] pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā [T 4.0378] nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca nadassanena pahātabbahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

89. Phenomena with a root to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena with a root not to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition. Phenomena with a root to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena with a root not to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for a phenomenon with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition… by way of the post-nascence condition. Phenomena with a root to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena with a root not to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for phenomena with a root to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena with a root not to be abandoned by seeing by way of the object condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the decisive support condition. (3)
