1. Conditions in Forward Order

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

149. Sappītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sappītikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Sappītiko dhammo appītikassa [V 4.0121] dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sappītikā hetū pītiyā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

149. A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon by way of root condition—joyful roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of root condition—joyful roots are a condition for joy and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (The root should be elaborated.) Joyful roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, for joy, and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – appītikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of root condition—roots unaccompanied by joy are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

150. Sappītiko [M 4.0103] dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sappītike khandhe ārabbha sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ārabbha appītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ārabbha sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (3)

150. A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon by way of object condition—taking joyful aggregates as object, joyful aggregates arise. (The root should be elaborated.) Taking joyful aggregates as object, aggregates unaccompanied by joy and joy arise. (The root should be elaborated.) Taking joyful aggregates as object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. (3)

151. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 4.0413] paccayo – appītikena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā appītikena cittena paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha appītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati; appītikā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalā vuṭṭhahitvā appītikena cittena phalaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā appītikena cittena nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ appītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya pītiyā ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā appītikena cittena appītike pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca appītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha appītiko rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; appītikā khandhā [V 4.0122] iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya pītiyā ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; appītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha appītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (1)

151. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of object condition—having given a gift with a mind unaccompanied by joy, having observed morality…pe… having performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews it with a mind unaccompanied by joy, relishes it, and delights in it. Taking that as object, lust unaccompanied by joy arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, mental pain arises. Having emerged from jhānas unaccompanied by joy…pe… having emerged from paths…pe… having emerged from fruits, one reviews the fruit with a mind unaccompanied by joy. Noble ones review Nibbāna with a mind unaccompanied by joy. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruit unaccompanied by joy, and for adverting and for joy, by way of object condition. Noble ones, with a mind unaccompanied by joy, discern as impermanent…pe… the abandoned defilements unaccompanied by joy…pe… the suppressed defilements…pe… previously…pe… the eye…pe… the base, and the aggregates unaccompanied by joy and joy; they relish and delight in them. Taking that as object, lust unaccompanied by joy arises…pe… mental pain arises. With the divine eye one sees a form…pe… the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. Aggregates unaccompanied by joy are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, knowledge of others’ minds, knowledge of recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings, knowledge of the future, and for adverting and for joy, by way of object condition. Taking aggregates unaccompanied by joy and joy as object, aggregates unaccompanied by joy and joy arise. (1)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – appītikena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… sappītikena cittena paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sappītiko rāgo [T 4.0414] uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; appītikā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalā vuṭṭhahitvā sappītikena cittena phalaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā sappītikena cittena nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ sappītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā sappītikena cittena appītike pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese [M 4.0104] …pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca sappītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sappītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; appītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A joyless phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms with a joyless mind, observed morality… performed the Uposatha duty… one reviews it with a joyful mind, relishes it, and delights in it; taking that as an object, joyful lust arises, wrong view arises. Having emerged from joyless jhānas… from paths… from fruits, one reviews the fruit with a joyful mind. Noble ones review Nibbāna with a joyful mind. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object for the joyful change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruit. Noble ones with a joyful mind review the joyless, abandoned defilements… the suppressed defilements… previously… the eye… the base, the joyless aggregates and joy, and with a joyful mind discern them as impermanent… relish, and delight in them; taking that as an object, joyful lust arises, wrong view arises. Taking the joyless aggregates and joy as an object, joyful aggregates arise. (2)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – appītikena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… sappītikena cittena paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti, appītikā jhānā…pe… maggā…pe… phalā vuṭṭhahitvā sappītikena cittena phalaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā sappītikena cittena nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ sappītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, pītiyā ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā sappītikena cittena appītike pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca sappītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati[T 4.0415], taṃ ārabbha sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti, appītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (3)

A joyless phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon and a joyless phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms with a joyless mind, observed morality… performed the Uposatha duty… one reviews it with a joyful mind, relishes it, and delights in it; taking that as an object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. Having emerged from joyless jhānas… from paths… from fruits, one reviews the fruit with a joyful mind. Noble ones with a joyful mind review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object for the joyful change-of-lineage, purification, path, fruit, and joy. Noble ones with a joyful mind review the joyless, abandoned defilements, the suppressed defilements… previously… the eye… the base. With a joyful mind, one discerns the joyless aggregates and joy as impermanent..., relishes, and delights in them; taking that as an object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. Taking the joyless aggregates and joy as an object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. (3)

152. Sappītiko [V 4.0123] ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha appītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti.

152. Joyful and joyless phenomena are a condition for a joyful phenomenon by way of object condition—taking joyful aggregates and joy as an object, joyful aggregates arise. (The root should be elaborated.) Taking joyful aggregates and joy as an object, joyless aggregates and joy arise.

(Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca ārabbha sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (3)

(The root should be elaborated.) Taking joyful aggregates and joy as an object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

153. Sappītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – sappītike khandhe garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – sappītikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

153. A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having made the joyful aggregates a weighty object, joyful aggregates arise. Conascence-dominance: a joyful dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Sappītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – sappītike khandhe garuṃ katvā appītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – sappītikādhipati [M 4.0105] pītiyā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a joyless phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having made the joyful aggregates a weighty object, joyless aggregates and joy arise. Conascence-dominance: a joyful dominant factor is a condition for joy and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Sappītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – sappītike khandhe garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – sappītikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ [T 4.0416] khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A joyful phenomenon is a condition for a joyful phenomenon and a joyless phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having made the joyful aggregates a weighty object, joyful aggregates and joy arise. Conascence-dominance: a joyful dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates, for joy, and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

154. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – appītikena cittena dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… appītikena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti [V 4.0124] abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā appītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; appītikā jhānā…pe… maggā…pe… phalā vuṭṭhahitvā appītikena cittena phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; ariyā appītikena cittena nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ appītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca appītikena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā appītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, appītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā appītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – appītikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

154. A joyless phenomenon is a condition for a joyless phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: with a joyless mind, one makes giving… morality… the Uposatha duty a weighty object and reviews, savors, and delights in it. Having made it a weighty object, joyless greed arises, wrong view arises. Having emerged from joyless jhānas… from paths… from fruitions, one reviews the fruition with a joyless mind, having made it a weighty object. Noble ones review Nibbāna with a joyless mind, having made it a weighty object. Nibbāna is a condition by way of dominance for the joyless change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruition. Having made the eye… the base, the joyless aggregates, and joy a weighty object with a joyless mind, one savors and delights in them. Having made them a weighty object, joyless greed arises, wrong view arises. Having made the joyless aggregates and joy a weighty object, joyless aggregates and joy arise. Conascence-dominance: a joyless dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – appītikena cittena dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ) nibbānaṃ sappītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca sappītikena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ [T 4.0417] garuṃ katvā sappītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; appītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A state not accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: with a mind not accompanied by joy, giving…pe… virtue…pe… observance of the Uposatha…pe… (abbreviated). Nibbāna is a condition by way of predominance for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruition accompanied by joy. Having taken the eye…pe… the base, the aggregates not accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object with a mind accompanied by joy, one savors and delights in them. Having taken that as a weighty object, greed accompanied by joy arises, wrong view arises. Having taken the aggregates not accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object, aggregates accompanied by joy arise. (2)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ) nibbānaṃ sappītikassa gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, pītiyā ca adhipatipaccayena [M 4.0106] paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītike khandhe ca pītiñca sappītikena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati appītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (3)

A state not accompanied by joy is a condition for both a state accompanied by joy and a state not accompanied by joy by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: giving…pe… (abbreviated). Nibbāna is a condition by way of predominance for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruition accompanied by joy, and for joy. Having taken the eye…pe… the base, the aggregates not accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object with a mind accompanied by joy, one savors and delights in them. Having taken that as a weighty object, greed arises, wrong view arises. Having taken the aggregates not accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object, aggregates accompanied by joy and joy arise. (3)

155. Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā appītikā khandhā ca [V 4.0125] pīti ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītike khandhe ca pītiñca garuṃ katvā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca uppajjanti. (3)

155. States accompanied by joy and not accompanied by joy are a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: having taken the aggregates accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object, aggregates accompanied by joy arise. (The root should be applied.) Having taken the aggregates accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object, aggregates not accompanied by joy and joy arise. (The root should be applied.) Having taken the aggregates accompanied by joy and joy as a weighty object, aggregates accompanied by joy and joy arise. (3)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

156. Sappītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā pacchimāya pacchimāya pītiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo – sappītikaṃ cuticittaṃ appītikassa upapatticittassa[T 4.0418], sappītikaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, sappītikā khandhā appītikassa vuṭṭhānassa, pītisahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā, sappītikaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ appītikassa bhavaṅgassa, sappītikaṃ kusalākusalaṃ appītikassa vuṭṭhānassa, kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

156. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition—preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition. (The root should be applied.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for subsequent joy by way of contiguity condition—a death-consciousness accompanied by joy for a rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by joy; a life-continuum accompanied by joy for adverting; aggregates accompanied by joy for an emergence not accompanied by joy; a resultant mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy for a functional mind-consciousness element; a life-continuum accompanied by joy for a life-continuum not accompanied by joy; wholesome or unwholesome states accompanied by joy for an emergence not accompanied by joy; a functional state for emergence; a fruition state for emergence, is a condition by way of contiguity. (The root should be applied.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by way of contiguity condition. (3)

157. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pīti pacchimāya pacchimāya pītiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā appītikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ appītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… appītikāya phalasamāpattiyā pītiyā ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā pīti pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; appītikaṃ cuticittaṃ sappītikassa upapatticittassa, āvajjanā sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ, appītikā khandhā sappītikassa vuṭṭhānassa, vipākamanodhātu sappītikāya vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā, appītikaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ [M 4.0107] sappītikassa bhavaṅgassa, appītikaṃ kusalākusalaṃ sappītikassa vuṭṭhānassa, kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ sappītikāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

157. A state not accompanied by joy is a condition for a state not accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition—preceding joy is a condition for subsequent joy by way of contiguity condition; preceding aggregates not accompanied by joy are a condition for subsequent aggregates not accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition; adaptation for change-of-lineage…pe… for fruition attainment not accompanied by joy and for joy is a condition by way of contiguity. (The root should be applied.) Preceding joy is a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition; a death-consciousness not accompanied by joy for a rebirth-consciousness accompanied by joy; adverting for aggregates accompanied by joy; aggregates not accompanied by joy for an emergence accompanied by joy; a resultant mind-element for a resultant mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy; a life-continuum not accompanied by joy for a life-continuum accompanied by joy; wholesome or unwholesome states not accompanied by joy for an emergence accompanied by joy; a functional state for emergence; a fruition state for emergence, is a condition by way of contiguity; for one arising from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa [T 4.0419] ca appītikassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pīti pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state not accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and a state not accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition—preceding joy is a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by way of contiguity condition. (3)

158. Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [V 4.0126] – purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

158. States accompanied by joy and not accompanied by joy are conditions for a state accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition—preceding aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are conditions for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā appītikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca pacchimāya pacchimāya pītiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo; sappītikaṃ cuticittañca pīti ca appītikassa upapatticittassa… sappītikaṃ bhavaṅgañca pīti ca āvajjanāya… sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca appītikassa vuṭṭhānassa… sappītikā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu ca pīti ca kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… sappītikaṃ bhavaṅgañca pīti ca appītikassa bhavaṅgassa… sappītikaṃ kusalākusalañca pīti ca appītikassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyañca pīti ca vuṭṭhānassa… phalañca pīti ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena accompanied by joy and phenomena not accompanied by joy are a condition for a phenomenon not accompanied by joy by contiguity condition—preceding aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are a condition for subsequent joy by contiguity condition; death-consciousness accompanied by joy and joy for rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by joy…; life-continuum accompanied by joy and joy for adverting…; aggregates accompanied by joy and joy for emergence not accompanied by joy…; resultant mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy and joy for functional mind-consciousness element…; life-continuum accompanied by joy and joy for a life-continuum not accompanied by joy…; wholesome or unwholesome states accompanied by joy and joy for emergence not accompanied by joy…; a functional state and joy for emergence…; a fruition state and joy for emergence are a condition by contiguity condition. (2)

Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Phenomena accompanied by joy and phenomena not accompanied by joy are a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon not accompanied by joy by contiguity condition—preceding aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by contiguity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava… nissayapaccayena [T 4.0420] paccayo… nava.

By way of proximity condition... nine... by way of co-nascence condition... nine... by way of mutuality condition... nine... by way of dependence condition... nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

159. Sappītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – sappītikā khandhā sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena [M 4.0108] paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītikā [V 4.0127] khandhā appītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītikā khandhā sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

159. A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…and so on. Natural decisive support—aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for aggregates accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be elaborated.) Aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for aggregates unaccompanied by joy and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be elaborated.) Aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (3)

160. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appītikaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appītikena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; appītikaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ… maggaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; appītikaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… pītiṃ upanissāya appītikena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; appītikā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ pīti ca appītikāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

160. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…and so on. Natural decisive support—relying on faith unaccompanied by joy, one gives a gift with a mind unaccompanied by joy, undertakes the precepts, performs the Uposatha observance; relying on jhāna unaccompanied by joy…and so on…insight…path…higher knowledge…attainment, one generates conceit, grasps wrong view; relying on virtue unaccompanied by joy…and so on…wisdom…lust…hatred…delusion…conceit…wrong view…aspiration…bodily pleasure…bodily pain…climate…food…lodging…relying on joy, one gives a gift with a mind unaccompanied by joy…and so on…generates attainment, kills living beings…and so on…splits the Saṅgha; faith unaccompanied by joy…and so on…lodging, and joy are a condition for faith unaccompanied by joy…and so on…aspiration…for bodily pleasure…for bodily pain…for the path, for fruition-attainment, and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi upanissayā). Appītikaṃ saddhaṃ [T 4.0421] upanissāya sappītikena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… appītikā jhānā…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; appītikaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ pītiṃ upanissāya sappītikena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; sappītikena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā…pe… pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti; appītikā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ pīti ca sappītikāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya rāgassa, mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition (three decisive supports). Relying on faith unaccompanied by joy, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy…and so on; relying on jhāna unaccompanied by joy…and so on, one generates conceit, grasps wrong view; relying on virtue unaccompanied by joy…and so on…lodging, and joy, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy…and so on…generates attainment; with a mind accompanied by joy, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely…and so on…slanderous speech…and so on…frivolous speech…and so on…commits burglary…and so on…plundering…and so on…robbing a single house…and so on…highway robbery…and so on…adultery…and so on…commits village-raiding…and so on…town-raiding; faith unaccompanied by joy…and so on…lodging, and joy are a condition for faith accompanied by joy…and so on…wisdom, for lust, for delusion…for conceit…for wrong view…for aspiration…for the path, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi upanissayā). Appītikaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sappītikena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; appītikaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ [V 4.0128] pītiṃ upanissāya sappītikena [M 4.0109] cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; sappītikena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… (dutiyavārasadisaṃ) nigamaghātaṃ karoti; appītikā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ pīti ca sappītikāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for both a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition (three decisive supports). Relying on faith unaccompanied by joy, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy…and so on…generates attainment, generates conceit, grasps wrong view; relying on virtue unaccompanied by joy…and so on…lodging, and joy, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy…and so on…generates attainment; with a mind accompanied by joy, one takes what is not given…and so on…(similar to the second section)…commits town-raiding; faith unaccompanied by joy…and so on…lodging, and joy are a condition for faith accompanied by joy…and so on…wisdom…for lust…for delusion…for conceit…for wrong view…for aspiration…for the path, for fruition-attainment, and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇipi upanissayā). Sappītikā khandhā ca [T 4.0422] pīti ca sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca appītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Sappītikā khandhā ca pīti ca sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Phenomena accompanied by joy and phenomena not accompanied by joy are a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition (all three decisive supports). Aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are a condition for aggregates accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be elaborated.) Aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are a condition for aggregates unaccompanied by joy and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be elaborated.) Aggregates accompanied by joy and joy are a condition for aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

161. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ appītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha appītiko rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu appītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

161. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one discerns the eye…etc.… or the base as impermanent with a mind unaccompanied by joy…etc., relishes, rejoices in it; based on that, lust unaccompanied by joy…etc.… grief arises, joy arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms…etc.… the tactile sense base is a condition for body-consciousness…etc. Base pre-nascence—the eye sense base is a condition for eye-consciousness…etc.… the body sense base is a condition for body-consciousness…etc.… the base is a condition for the aggregates unaccompanied by joy and for joy by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ sappītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sappītiko rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one discerns the eye…etc.… or the base as impermanent with a mind accompanied by joy…etc., relishes, rejoices in it; based on that, lust accompanied by joy arises, wrong view arises. Base pre-nascence—the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by joy by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo [V 4.0129] – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ sappītikena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha [T 4.0423] pīti ca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ [M 4.0110] – vatthu sappītikānaṃ khandhānaṃ pītiyā ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for both a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one discerns the eye…etc.… or the base as impermanent with a mind accompanied by joy…etc., relishes, rejoices in it; based on that, joy and the associated aggregates arise. Base pre-nascence—the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by joy and for joy by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayādi

Post-nascence Condition, etc.

162. Sappītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava… kammapaccayena paccayo… cha (sahajātāpi nānākkhaṇikāpi kātabbā… dve nānākkhaṇikā)… vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… nava… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha… vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca… atthipaccayena paccayo… nava (saṃkhittaṃ. Savitakkadukasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ.)… Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo… nava.

162. A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of Post-nascence Condition… three… by way of Repetition Condition… nine… by way of Kamma Condition… six (both co-arising and non-co-arising should be done… two non-co-arising)… by way of Result Condition… nine… by way of Nutriment Condition… four… by way of Faculty Condition… four… by way of Jhāna Condition… nine… by way of Path Condition… four… by way of Association Condition… six… by way of Dissociation Condition… five… by way of Presence Condition… nine (summarized. It should be done like the dyad of initial thought.)… by way of Absence Condition… by way of Disappearance Condition… by way of Non-disappearance Condition… nine.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Analysis of Conditions in Forward Order

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

163. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cha, vipāke nava, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne nava, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

163. By way of Root Condition, four; by way of Object Condition, nine; by way of Dominance Condition, nine; by way of Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of Co-arising Condition, nine; by way of Reciprocity Condition, nine; by way of Dependence Condition, nine; by way of Decisive Support Condition, nine; by way of Pre-nascence Condition, three; by way of Post-nascence Condition, three; by way of Repetition Condition, nine; by way of Kamma Condition, six; by way of Result Condition, nine; by way of Nutriment Condition, four; by way of Faculty Condition, four; by way of Jhāna Condition, nine; by way of Path Condition, four; by way of Association Condition, six; by way of Dissociation Condition, five; by way of Presence Condition, nine; by way of Absence Condition, nine; by way of Disappearance Condition, nine; by way of Non-disappearance Condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Order.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Summary of Opposing Factors

164. Sappītiko [V 4.0130] dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 4.0424] paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. Sappītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. Sappītiko [M 4.0111] dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

164. A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Post-nascence Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for phenomena accompanied by joy and unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. (3)

165. Appītiko dhammo appītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. Appītiko dhammo sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

165. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Pre-nascence Condition… by way of Post-nascence Condition… by way of Kamma Condition… by way of Nutriment Condition… by way of Faculty Condition. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Pre-nascence Condition. A phenomenon unaccompanied by joy is a condition for phenomena accompanied by joy and unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Pre-nascence Condition. (3)

166. Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo[T 4.0425]. Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā appītikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Sappītiko ca appītiko ca dhammā sappītikassa ca appītikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

166. Both a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy are conditions for a phenomenon accompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition. Both a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy are conditions for a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Post-nascence Condition. Both a phenomenon accompanied by joy and a phenomenon unaccompanied by joy are conditions for phenomena accompanied by joy and unaccompanied by joy by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-arising Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition. (3)

(Paccanīyavibhaṅgagaṇanāpi savitakkadukasadisā. Yadipi na sameti imaṃ anulomaṃ paccavekkhitvā gaṇetabbaṃ, itare dve gaṇanā gaṇetabbā.)

(The enumeration of the reverse analysis is similar to the dyad of initial thought. If it does not correspond, one should review this direct order and then count. The other two enumerations should be counted.)

Sappītikadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of Accompanied by Joy is finished.

90. Pītisahagatadukaṃ

90. The Dyad of Accompanied by Zest

1-7. Paṭiccavārādi

1-7. The Section on Dependent Arising, etc.

167. Pītisahagataṃ [V 4.0131] dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – pītisahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (evaṃ [M 4.0112] pītisahagatadukaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ, sappītikadukasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ, āmasanaṃ ninnānaṃ.)

167. A phenomenon accompanied by zest arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by zest by way of Root Condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by zest, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates… (Thus the dyad accompanied by zest should be elaborated in detail, similar to the dyad with zest, without distinction; the treatment is the same.)

Pītisahagatadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad Accompanied by Zest is finished.

91. Sukhasahagatadukaṃ

91. The Dyad Accompanied by Happiness

1-6. Paṭiccavārādi

1-6. The Conditional Section, etc.

1-4. Paccayānulomādi

1-4. Conditionality in Forward Order, etc.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

168. Sukhasahagataṃ [T 4.0426] dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sukhasahagate khandhe paṭicca sukhaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (Evaṃ sukhasahagatadukaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ, yathā sappītikadukassa anulomapaṭiccavāro.)

168. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by happiness, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; at the moment of rebirth-linking… A phenomenon not accompanied by happiness arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates accompanied by happiness, happiness and mind-originated material form arise. (Thus, the dyad accompanied by happiness should be elaborated in detail, like the forward conditional section of the dyad with zest.)

Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava…pe… purejāte cha, āsevane cha, kamme nava…pe… avigate nava.

By way of root, nine; by way of object, nine… by way of pre-nascence, six; by way of repetition, six; by way of kamma, nine… by way of non-disappearance, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order

169. Sukhasahagataṃ [V 4.0132] dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Ahetuke sukhasahagate khandhe paṭicca sukhañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato ca nasukhasahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā sukhañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

169. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by happiness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… (The root should be applied.) Dependent on rootless aggregates accompanied by happiness, happiness and mind-originated material form arise. Dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by happiness, phenomena accompanied by happiness and phenomena not accompanied by happiness arise by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by happiness, two aggregates, happiness, and mind-originated material form arise; dependent on two aggregates… (3)

Nasukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nasukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukaṃ sukhaṃ paṭicca [T 4.0427] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe nasukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ [M 4.0113] …pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (Yāva asaññasattā) vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (Yathā sappītike nahetupaccayasadisaṃ, ninnānaṃ sabbatthameva nava pañhā.)

A phenomenon not accompanied by happiness arises dependent on a phenomenon not accompanied by happiness by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate not accompanied by happiness, three aggregates and mind-originated material form… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on rootless happiness, mind-originated material form; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate not accompanied by happiness, three aggregates and kamma-born material form… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; one great element… (Up to non-percipient beings.) Dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (Similar to the non-root condition of the dyad with zest; the same in all nine questions.)

Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne cha, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

By way of non-root, nine; by way of non-object, three… by way of non-decisive support, three; by way of non-pre-nascence, nine; by way of non-post-nascence, nine; by way of non-repetition, nine; by way of non-kamma, four; by way of non-result, nine; by way of non-nutriment, one; by way of non-faculty, one; by way of non-jhāna, six; by way of non-path, nine; by way of non-association, three; by way of non-dissociation, six; by way of non-absence, three; by way of non-disappearance, three.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative

(Evaṃ itare dve gaṇanāpi sahajātavāropi paṭiccavārasadisā. Paccayavāre pavattipi paṭisandhipi vitthāretabbā, yathā sappītikadukapaccayavārapaccanīyepi pavatte vatthu ca vitthāretabbaṃ, yathā sappītikaduke ekoyeva moho, evaṃ itare dve gaṇanāpi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi yathā sappītikadukaṃ, evaṃ kātabbaṃ.)

(Thus, the other two enumerations and the co-nascence section are similar to the conditional section. In the condition section, both the process and rebirth-linking should be elaborated. Just as in the negative part of the condition section of the dyad with zest, the base should also be elaborated in the process. Just as in the dyad with zest there is only delusion, so too the other two enumerations, the dependence section, the conjoined section, and the associated section should be done as with the dyad with zest.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. The Question Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conditionality in Forward Order

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Analytical Section

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

170. Sukhasahagato [V 4.0133] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo… cattāri. (Ārammaṇepi adhipatiyāpi sappītikadukasadisā, sukhanti nānākaraṇaṃ.)

170. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of root condition… four. (Also for object condition and dominance condition, it is similar to the dyad with zest; happiness is the distinguishing factor.)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Contiguous Condition, etc.

171. Sukhasahagato [T 4.0428] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sukhasahagatā [M 4.0114] khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa sukhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ cuticittaṃ nasukhasahagatassa upapatticittassa… sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ vipākamanodhātuyā… sukhasahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ nasukhasahagatassa bhavaṅgassa… sukhasahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ nasukhasahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ sukhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

171. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of immediately contiguous condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of immediately contiguous condition. (The root should be applied.) The preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent happiness by way of immediately contiguous condition. Death-consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition for rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by happiness… life-continuum accompanied by happiness for adverting… body-consciousness accompanied by happiness for the resultant mind-element… the resultant mind-consciousness-element accompanied by happiness for the functional mind-consciousness-element… life-continuum accompanied by happiness for the life-continuum not accompanied by happiness… wholesome or unwholesome consciousness accompanied by happiness for emergence not accompanied by happiness… functional consciousness for emergence… fruition for emergence by way of immediately contiguous condition. (The root should be applied.) The preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness and for happiness by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Nasukhasahagato dhammo nasukhasahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nasukhasahagatā…pe…. (Mūlaṃ. Tīṇipi sappītikadukasadisā.)

A phenomenon not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon not accompanied by happiness by way of immediately contiguous condition—the preceding, preceding phenomena not accompanied by happiness… (The root should be applied. All three are similar to the dyad with zest.)

172. Sukhasahagato ca nasukhasahagato ca dhammā sukhasahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā ca sukhañca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ [V 4.0134] anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā ca sukhañca pacchimassa pacchimassa sukhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; sukhasahagataṃ cuticittañca sukhañca nasukhasahagatassa upapatticittassa sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgañca sukhañca āvajjanāya [T 4.0429]… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇañca sukhañca vipākamanodhātuyā… sukhasahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu ca sukhañca kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgañca sukhañca nasukhasahagatassa bhavaṅgassa… sukhasahagataṃ kusalākusalañca sukhañca nasukhasahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā ca sukhañca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ sukhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

172. Phenomena accompanied by happiness and phenomena not accompanied by happiness are a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of immediacy condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be applied.) The preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent happiness by way of immediacy condition; the death-consciousness accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by happiness; the life-continuum accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for adverting…; the body-consciousness accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the resultant mind-element…; the resultant mind-consciousness element accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the functional mind-consciousness element…; the life-continuum accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the life-continuum not accompanied by happiness…; the wholesome and unwholesome accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for emergence not accompanied by happiness…; the functional, for emergence…; the fruition, for emergence, are conditions by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be applied.) The preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness and happiness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness and for happiness by way of immediacy condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo.

As contiguity condition…; as co-nascence condition…; as mutuality condition…; as dependence condition.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive-Support Condition

173. Sukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

173. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive-support condition… three.

Nasukhasahagato [M 4.0115] dhammo nasukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nasukhasahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya nasukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; nasukhasahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya nasukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; nasukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ sukhañca nasukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa… dosassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā [T 4.0430] sukhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state not accompanied by happiness by way of decisive-support condition: as object decisive-support, as contiguity decisive-support, as natural decisive-support… As natural decisive-support: relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with a mind not accompanied by happiness one gives a gift, observes precepts… attains meditative absorption, generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… wisdom… lust… aspiration… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… comfortable lodging, with a mind not accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… attains meditative absorption, kills living beings… divides the Saṅgha; faith not accompanied by happiness… and comfortable lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for faith not accompanied by happiness… for wisdom… for lust… for hatred… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, and for the happiness of fruition-attainment. (1)

Nasukhasahagato [V 4.0135] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nasukhasahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; nasukhasahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; sukhasahagatena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati; musā…pe… pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti; nasukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ sukhañca sukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive-support condition: as object decisive-support, as contiguity decisive-support, as natural decisive-support… As natural decisive-support: relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with a mind accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… attains meditative absorption, generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… wisdom… lust… aspiration… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… comfortable lodging, with a mind accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… attains meditative absorption; with a mind accompanied by happiness, one takes what is not given… lies… slanders… engages in frivolous talk… commits burglary… plunders… commits dacoity… sets an ambush… commits adultery… destroys villages… destroys towns; faith not accompanied by happiness… and comfortable lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for faith accompanied by happiness… for wisdom… for lust… for conceit… for a view… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for the path, and for fruition-attainment. (2)

Nasukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa ca nasukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nasukhasahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… (dutiyagamanasadisaṃ) mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; nasukhasahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, sukhasahagatena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… nasukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ sukhañca sukhasahagatāya [M 4.0116]… saddhāya…pe… patthanāya [T 4.0431]… kāyikassa sukhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā sukhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for both a state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness by way of decisive-support condition: as object decisive-support, as contiguity decisive-support, as natural decisive-support… As natural decisive-support: relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with a mind accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… (similar to the second case) generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… comfortable lodging, one gives a gift… attains meditative absorption; with a mind accompanied by happiness, one takes what is not given… Faith not accompanied by happiness… and comfortable lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for faith accompanied by happiness… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure, for the path, and for the happiness of fruition-attainment. (3)

Sukhasahagato ca nasukhasahagato ca dhammā sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness are conditions for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive-support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayādi

Pre-nascence Condition, etc.

174. Nasukhasahagato dhammo nasukhasahagatassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nasukhasahagatena cittena [V 4.0136] aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha nasukhasahagato rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, sukhaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nasukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ sukhassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

174. A state not accompanied by pleasure is a condition for a state not accompanied by pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… the base is contemplated as impermanent… with a mind not accompanied by pleasure, one savors it, delights in it; taking that as object, lust not accompanied by pleasure arises… displeasure arises, pleasure arises; with the divine eye one sees form… the tactile base for body-consciousness… Base pre-nascence: the eye-base for eye-consciousness… the body-base for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the aggregates not accompanied by pleasure and for pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nasukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ sukhasahagatena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sukhasahagato rāgo uppajjati[T 4.0432], diṭṭhi uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state not accompanied by pleasure is a condition for a state accompanied by pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… the base is contemplated as impermanent… with a mind accompanied by pleasure, one savors it, delights in it; taking that as object, lust accompanied by pleasure arises, a view arises. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nasukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa ca nasukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ sukhasahagatena cittena aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sukhañca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ sukhassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state not accompanied by pleasure is a condition for both a state accompanied by pleasure and a state not accompanied by pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… the base is contemplated as impermanent… with a mind accompanied by pleasure, one savors it, delights in it; taking that as object, pleasure and the associated aggregates arise. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by pleasure and for pleasure by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

By way of post-nascence condition… three… by way of repetition condition… nine.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, etc.

175. Sukhasahagato [M 4.0117] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. (Cha kammāni cattāri sahajātāpi nānākkhaṇikāpi kātabbā, dve nānākkhaṇikā.)… Vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… nava… jhānapaccayena paccayo… nava… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha… vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca… atthipaccayena paccayo… nava… natthipaccayena paccayo… nava… vigatapaccayena paccayo… nava… avigatapaccayena paccayo… nava.

175. A phenomenon accompanied by pleasure is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by pleasure by way of kamma condition—co-arisen, and occurring at different moments. (Six kamma are to be understood as four that are co-arisen and also occurring at different moments, and two that are occurring at different moments.)… By result condition… nine… by nutriment condition… four… by faculty condition… nine… by jhāna condition… nine… by path condition… four… by association condition… six… by dissociation condition… five… by presence condition… nine… by absence condition… nine… by disappearance condition… nine… by non-disappearance condition… nine.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Positive Section

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Chapter on Enumeration

Suddhaṃ

Pure

176. Hetuyā [V 4.0137] cattāri, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cha, vipāke nava, āhāre cattāri, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

176. By root condition, four; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-arisen condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, nine; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, six; by result condition, nine; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, nine; by path condition, four; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

(Evaṃ paccanīyavibhaṅgopi gaṇanāpi sappītikadukasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, yadipi vimati atthi anulomaṃ passitvā gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Thus the classification of the negative and the enumeration should be done in the same way as for the pair accompanied by zest; and if there is any doubt, one should count after reviewing the positive section.)

Sukhasahagatadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Duka on what is accompanied by pleasure is concluded.

92. Upekkhāsahagatadukaṃ

92. The Duka on what is accompanied by equanimity

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Chapter on Conditions

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Positive Section

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Classification

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

177. Upekkhāsahagataṃ [T 4.0433] dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe [M 4.0118] …pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ [V 4.0138] dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upekkhāsahagate khandhe paṭicca upekkhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā upekkhā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

177. A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity through a root condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. A phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity through a root condition—dependent on aggregates accompanied by equanimity, equanimity and mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. Phenomena accompanied by equanimity and phenomena not accompanied by equanimity arise dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity through a root condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity, two aggregates, equanimity, and mind-originated matter; dependent on two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. (3)

Naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – naupekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… upekkhaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe naupekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, upekkhaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca upekkhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (Sappītikadukasadisaṃ, anulome navapi pañhā.)

A phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity through a root condition—dependent on one aggregate not accompanied by equanimity, three aggregates and mind-originated matter;…etc.… dependent on two aggregates;…etc.… dependent on equanimity, mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate not accompanied by equanimity, three aggregates and kamma-originated matter;…etc.… dependent on two aggregates;…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on equanimity, kamma-originated matter; dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates; dependent on equanimity, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, equanimity; dependent on one great element;…etc. (Similar to the pair accompanied by zest, with nine questions in the positive section.)

178. Hetuyā [T 4.0434] nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava…pe… purejāte cha, āsevane cha, kamme nava (sabbattha nava), avigate nava.

178. By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine;…etc.… by pre-nascence condition, six; by repetition condition, six; by kamma condition, nine (nine in all); by non-disappearance condition, nine.
