1. The Chapter on Classification

Nahetupaccayo

Non-root Condition

179. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato [V 4.0139] uddhaccasahagato moho. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke upekkhāsahagate khandhe paṭicca upekkhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ [M 4.0119] paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā upekkhā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

179. A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by equanimity, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. A phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates accompanied by equanimity, equanimity and mind-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…. Phenomena accompanied by equanimity and phenomena not accompanied by equanimity arise dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by equanimity, two aggregates, equanimity, and mind-originated matter; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…. (3)

180. Naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ naupekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukaṃ upekkhaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… upekkhaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca upekkhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā).

180. A phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate not accompanied by equanimity, three aggregates and mind-originated matter… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on rootless equanimity, mind-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… dependent on equanimity, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, equanimity; dependent on one great element… (up to non-percipient beings).

Naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 4.0435] upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagatā khandhā; vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ upekkhaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho.

A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on rootless equanimity, associated aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on equanimity, associated aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates accompanied by equanimity; dependent on equanimity accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises.

Naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ahetukaṃ upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagatā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca upekkhā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Phenomena accompanied by equanimity and phenomena not accompanied by equanimity arise dependent on a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on rootless equanimity, associated aggregates and mind-originated matter; dependent on rootless equanimity, associated aggregates; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated matter. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on equanimity, associated aggregates and kamma-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on equanimity, associated aggregates; dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated matter. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates accompanied by equanimity; dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated matter. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, equanimity and associated aggregates. (3)

181. Upekkhāsahagatañca naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā[V 4.0140], dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca upekkhañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato [T 4.0436] moho.

181. A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity and a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity and the physical base, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates… dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and equanimity, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises.

Upekkhāsahagatañca [M 4.0120] naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca upekkhañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ahetuke upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca upekkhañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca upekkhā.

A phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity arises dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity and a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition—dependent on rootless aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, mind-originated matter; dependent on rootless aggregates accompanied by equanimity and the great elements, mind-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, kamma-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates accompanied by equanimity and the great elements, kamma-originated matter; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates accompanied by equanimity and the physical base, equanimity.

Upekkhāsahagatañca naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetuke upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca upekkhañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā [T 4.0437] ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upekkhañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetuke upekkhāsahagate khandhe ca upekkhañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā upekkhā ca, dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Phenomena accompanied by equanimity and phenomena not accompanied by equanimity arise dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity and a phenomenon not accompanied by equanimity by way of non-root condition. Dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates… dependent on one rootless aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… dependent on rootless aggregates accompanied by equanimity, equanimity, and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates and kamma-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity and equanimity, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… dependent on rootless aggregates accompanied by equanimity, equanimity, and the great elements, kamma-originated matter arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by equanimity and the physical base, two aggregates and equanimity arise; dependent on two aggregates… (Abbreviated). (3)

Pure

182. Nahetuyā [V 4.0141] nava, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne nava, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

182. By way of non-root condition, nine; by way of non-object condition, three; by way of non-predominance condition, nine; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-reciprocity condition, three; by way of non-decisive support condition, three; by way of non-prenascence condition, nine; by way of non-postnascence condition, nine; by way of non-repetition condition, nine; by way of non-kamma condition, four; by way of non-resultant condition, nine; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, nine; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-association condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, six; by way of non-absence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

183. Upekkhāsahagataṃ [M 4.0121] dhammaṃ paccayā upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yathā savitakkadukasadisaṃ paccayavāre nānākaraṇaṃ. “Upekkha”nti navapi pañhā kātabbā, paṭisandhipavattipi vatthupi.)

183. Conditioned by an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of root condition: conditioned by one equanimity-accompanied aggregate, two aggregates arise; conditioned by two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (as similar to the pair with initial application in the Conditional Relation Section, with variations. Nine questions should be formulated concerning ‘equanimity,’ and also concerning rebirth-linking, continuity, and the base.)

Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava…pe… purejāte nava, āsevane nava (sabbattha nava), avigate nava.

By way of root condition, nine; by way of object condition, nine… by way of prenascence condition, nine; by way of repetition condition, nine (nine in all cases); by way of presence condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

Direct Order.

184. Upekkhāsahagataṃ [T 4.0438][V 4.0142] dhammaṃ paccayā upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (Evaṃ navapi pañhā pavattipaṭisandhiyo yathā savitakkadukassa evaṃ kātabbā. Tīṇiyeva moho, pavatte vatthupi kātabbā.)

184. Conditioned by an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: conditioned by one rootless equanimity-accompanied aggregate, two aggregates arise; conditioned by two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… conditioned by doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates, doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion arises. (Thus, nine questions concerning continuity and rebirth-linking should be done as for the pair with initial application. Only three concerning delusion; in continuity, the base should also be done.)

Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

By way of non-root condition, nine; by way of non-object condition, three; by way of non-predominance condition, nine; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, three; by way of non-decisive support condition, three; by way of non-prenascence condition, nine; by way of non-postnascence condition, nine; by way of non-repetition condition, nine; by way of non-kamma condition, four; by way of non-resultant condition, nine; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, one; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-association condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, six; by way of non-absence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative Order.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

185. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe [M 4.0122] …pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Yathā savitakkadukaṃ sampayuttavāro evaṃ kātabbo.)

185. Associated with an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of root condition: two aggregates are associated with one equanimity-accompanied aggregate; two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (This should be done as for the pair with initial application in the Associated Section.)

Hetuyā [V 4.0143] cha, ārammaṇe cha (sabbattha cha), avigate cha.

By way of root condition, six; by way of object condition, six (six in all cases); by way of presence condition, six.

Anulomaṃ.

Direct Order.

Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve [T 4.0439] khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (Evaṃ pañca pañhā yathā savitakkaduke evaṃ kātabbā.)

Associated with an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: two aggregates are associated with one rootless equanimity-accompanied aggregate; two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion is associated with doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates. (Thus, five questions should be done as for the pair with initial application.)

Nahetuyā cha, naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, navippayutte cha.

By way of non-root condition, six; by way of non-predominance condition, six; by way of non-prenascence condition, six; by way of non-postnascence condition, six; by way of non-repetition condition, six; by way of non-kamma condition, four; by way of non-resultant condition, six; by way of non-dissociation condition, six.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative Order.

Hetupaccayādi

Root Condition, etc.

186. Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upekkhāsahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Evaṃ cattāri pañhā yathā savitakkadukassa.)

186. An equanimity-accompanied phenomenon is a condition for an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon by way of root condition: equanimity-accompanied roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... (Thus, four questions as for the pair with initial application.)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… adhipatipaccayena [V 4.0144] paccayo. (Yathā sappītikadukaṃ evaṃ ārammaṇampi adhipatipi vitthāretabbā, “upekkhā”ti nānaṃ.)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the object condition... by way of the dominance condition. (As in the dyad with joy, so the object and dominance should be elaborated, the difference being 'equanimity'.)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Proximate Condition, etc.

187. Upekkhāsahagato [M 4.0123] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

187. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity are conditions for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (1)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo naupekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 4.0440] paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimāya pacchimāya upekkhāya anantarapaccayena paccayo; upekkhāsahagataṃ cuticittaṃ naupekkhāsahagatassa upapatticittassa… āvajjanā naupekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ… vipākamanodhātu naupekkhāsahagatāya vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… upekkhāsahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ naupekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa… upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ naupekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ naupekkhāsahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity are conditions for the succeeding equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition; the death consciousness accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the rebirth consciousness not accompanied by equanimity... adverting is a condition for the aggregates not accompanied by equanimity... the resultant mind-element is a condition for the resultant mind-consciousness-element not accompanied by equanimity... the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the life-continuum not accompanied by equanimity... the wholesome or unwholesome accompanied by equanimity is a condition for emergence not accompanied by equanimity... the functional is a condition for emergence... the fruition is a condition for emergence... the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception of one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (2)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa ca naupekkhāsahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ upekkhāya ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity and for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity are conditions for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and for equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (3)

188. Naupekkhāsahagato dhammo naupekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhā pacchimāya pacchimāya upekkhāya anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā naupekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naupekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā upekkhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo[T 4.0441]; naupekkhāsahagataṃ cuticittaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa [V 4.0145] upapatticittassa… naupekkhāsahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… kāyaviññāṇadhātu vipākamanodhātuyā… naupekkhāsahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… naupekkhāsahagataṃ [M 4.0124] bhavaṅgaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa… naupekkhāsahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

188. A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding equanimity is a condition for the succeeding equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition; the preceding aggregates not accompanied by equanimity are conditions for the succeeding aggregates not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition; conformity is a condition for the change-of-lineage...pe... conformity is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root should be made.) A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding equanimity is a condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition; the death consciousness not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the rebirth consciousness accompanied by equanimity... the life-continuum not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for adverting... the body-consciousness-element is a condition for the resultant mind-element... the resultant mind-consciousness-element not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the functional mind-consciousness-element... the life-continuum not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity... the wholesome or unwholesome not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the emergence accompanied by equanimity... the functional is a condition for the emergence... the fruition is a condition for the emergence by way of the immediately proximate condition. (2)

Naupekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa ca naupekkhāsahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ upekkhāya ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity and for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding equanimity is a condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and for equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (3)

189. Upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā ca upekkhā ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā ca upekkhā ca pacchimāya pacchimāya upekkhāya anantarapaccayena paccayo; upekkhāsahagataṃ cuticittañca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatassa upapatticittassa… āvajjanā ca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ… vipākamanodhātu ca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatāya vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā… upekkhāsahagataṃ bhavaṅgañca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa… upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalākusalañca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyañca [T 4.0442] upekkhā ca vuṭṭhānassa… phalañca upekkhā ca vuṭṭhānassa… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanañca upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā ca upekkhā ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ upekkhāya ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

189. A state accompanied by equanimity and a state not accompanied by equanimity are conditions for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root should be made.) A state accompanied by equanimity and a state not accompanied by equanimity are conditions for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the succeeding equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition; the death consciousness accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the rebirth consciousness not accompanied by equanimity... adverting and equanimity are conditions for the aggregates not accompanied by equanimity... the resultant mind-element and equanimity are conditions for the resultant mind-consciousness-element not accompanied by equanimity... the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the life-continuum not accompanied by equanimity... the wholesome or unwholesome accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the emergence not accompanied by equanimity... the functional and equanimity are conditions for the emergence... the fruition and equanimity are conditions for the emergence... the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception of one emerging from cessation and equanimity are conditions for the attainment of fruition not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (The root should be made.) A state accompanied by equanimity and a state not accompanied by equanimity are conditions for a state accompanied by equanimity and for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are conditions for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and for equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

is a condition by way of contiguity condition... is a condition by way of conascence condition... nine... is a condition by way of mutuality condition... nine... is a condition by way of dependence condition... nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

190. Upekkhāsahagato [V 4.0146] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

190. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the decisive support condition… three.

Naupekkhāsahagato [M 4.0125] dhammo naupekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – naupekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya naupekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… naupekkhāsahagataṃ jhānaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ…pe… maggaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; naupekkhāsahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upekkhaṃ upanissāya naupekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; naupekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ upekkhā ca naupekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa [T 4.0443]… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upekkhāya ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. By way of natural decisive support: relying on faith not accompanied by equanimity, with a mind not accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift, undertakes morality… performs the Uposatha observance… produces jhāna not accompanied by equanimity… insight… the path… produces an attainment, gives rise to conceit, grasps a wrong view; relying on morality not accompanied by equanimity… wisdom… greed… aversion… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, and equanimity, with a mind not accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… creates a schism in the Saṅgha; faith not accompanied by equanimity… lodging, and equanimity are a condition for faith not accompanied by equanimity… for wisdom… for greed… for longing… for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for the path, for the attainment of fruition, and for equanimity by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Naupekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇipi upanissayā). Naupekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; naupekkhāsahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upekkhaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, upekkhāsahagatena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti; naupekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ upekkhā ca upekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition (all three decisive supports). Relying on faith not accompanied by equanimity, with a mind accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment, gives rise to conceit, grasps a wrong view; relying on morality not accompanied by equanimity… lodging, and equanimity, with a mind accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment; with a mind accompanied by equanimity, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks divisively… speaks idly… commits housebreaking… commits robbery… commits looting a single house… commits highway robbery… commits adultery… commits the destruction of a village… commits the destruction of a town; faith not accompanied by equanimity… lodging, and equanimity are a condition for faith accompanied by equanimity… for longing… for the path, and for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition.

Naupekkhāsahagato [V 4.0147] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa ca naupekkhāsahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi upanissayā dutiyagamanasadisā). (3)

A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity and for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition (three decisive supports, similar to the second exposition). (3)

Upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A state accompanied by equanimity and a state not accompanied by equanimity are a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

191. Naupekkhāsahagato [M 4.0126] dhammo naupekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (sappītikadukasadisā).

191. A state not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of prenascence condition… three (similar to the pair of states accompanied by joy).

Pacchājātapaccayādi

Post-nascence Condition, etc.

192. Upekkhāsahagato dhammo naupekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava… kammapaccayena paccayo… cha. (Cattāri sahajātā nānākkhaṇikā kātabbā[T 4.0444], dve nānākkhaṇikā ca.)… Vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… nava… jhānapaccayena paccayo… nava… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha… vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca… atthipaccayena paccayo… nava… natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (Imāni paccayāni sappītikakaraṇena vibhajitabbāni.)

192. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state not accompanied by equanimity by way of post-nascence condition… three… by way of repetition condition… nine… by way of kamma condition… six. (Four co-nascent and different-moment permutations should be done, and two different-moment ones.)… By way of result condition… nine… by way of nutriment condition… four… by way of faculty condition… nine… by way of jhāna condition… nine… by way of path condition… four… by way of association condition… six… by way of dissociation condition… five… by way of presence condition… nine… by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. (These conditions should be analyzed by applying the method used for the pair of states accompanied by joy.)

2. Section on Enumeration

Suddhaṃ

Simple Enumeration

193. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava[V 4.0148], sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cha, vipāke nava, āhāre cattāri, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

193. In root condition, four; in object, nine; in predominance, nine; in contiguity, nine; in immediate contiguity, nine; in co-nascence, nine; in mutuality, nine; in dependence, nine; in decisive support, nine; in prenascence, three; in post-nascence, three; in repetition, nine; in kamma, six; in result, nine; in nutriment, four; in faculty, nine; in jhāna, nine; in path, four; in association, six; in dissociation, five; in presence, nine; in absence, nine; in disappearance, nine; in non-disappearance, nine.

(Evaṃ paccanīyavibhaṅgopi itare tīṇi gaṇanāpi sappītikadukasadisā kātabbā.)

(Likewise, the negative analysis and the other three enumerations should also be done in the same way as for the pair concerning states accompanied by joy.)

Upekkhāsahagatadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Duka on States Accompanied by Equanimity is concluded.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

194. Kāmāvacaraṃ [T 4.0445][M 4.0127] dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). Kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacarā khandhā. Kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacarā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

194. Dependent on a sensuous-sphere state, a sensuous-sphere state arises by way of root condition: dependent on one sensuous-sphere aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on one great element… (in brief). Dependent on a sensuous-sphere state, a non-sensuous-sphere state arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, non-sensuous-sphere aggregates arise. Dependent on a sensuous-sphere state, a sensuous-sphere state and a non-sensuous-sphere state arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, non-sensuous-sphere aggregates arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-born matter arises. (3)

195. Nakāmāvacaraṃ [V 4.0149] dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nakāmāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nakāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nakāmāvacare khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nakāmāvacare khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Nakāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nakāmāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

195. With a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon arises by way of root condition: with one non-sensuous-sphere aggregate as condition, three aggregates… with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. With a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, a sensuous-sphere phenomenon arises by way of root condition: with non-sensuous-sphere aggregates as condition, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, with non-sensuous-sphere aggregates as condition, kamma-produced materiality arises. With a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, both sensuous-sphere and non-sensuous-sphere phenomena arise by way of root condition: with one non-sensuous-sphere aggregate as condition, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise… with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

196. Kāmāvacarañca nakāmāvacarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 4.0446] – nakāmāvacare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nakāmāvacare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Kāmāvacarañca nakāmāvacarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe nakāmāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. Kāmāvacarañca nakāmāvacarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe nakāmāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… nakāmāvacare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

196. With a sensuous-sphere phenomenon and a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, a sensuous-sphere phenomenon arises by way of root condition: with non-sensuous-sphere aggregates and the great elements as condition, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, with non-sensuous-sphere aggregates and the great elements as condition, kamma-produced materiality arises. With a sensuous-sphere phenomenon and a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, with one non-sensuous-sphere aggregate and the physical base as condition, three aggregates… with two aggregates…. With a sensuous-sphere phenomenon and a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon as condition, both sensuous-sphere and non-sensuous-sphere phenomena arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, with one non-sensuous-sphere aggregate and the physical base as condition, three aggregates… with two aggregates… with non-sensuous-sphere aggregates and the great elements as condition, kamma-produced materiality arises. (3) (In brief.)

Suddhaṃ

Pure Section

197. Hetuyā [M 4.0128] nava, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, āsevane dve, kamme nava, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte cattāri, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate nava.

197. Nakāmāvacarā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of root condition—non-sensuous-sphere roots are conditions for associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. A non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of root condition—non-sensuous-sphere roots are conditions for mind-originated form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (The root should be done.) Non-sensuous-sphere roots are conditions for associated aggregates and mind-originated form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

207. Kāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti[V 4.0157], vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti; pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe [T 4.0453] suciṇṇāni…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ kāmāvacare khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

207. A sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms, morality... Uposatha observance... one reviews, delights in, and rejoices in past good deeds; based on that, lust... grief arises; noble ones review change-of-lineage, review purification; abandoned defilements... suppressed defilements... past good deeds... the eye... the base, the sensuous-sphere aggregates as impermanent... grief arises; the visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. (1)

Kāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena kāmāvacaracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, kāmāvacarā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition—one sees forms with the divine eye, hears sounds with the divine ear-element, knows the mind of one endowed with sensuous-sphere consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge; the sensuous-sphere aggregates are conditions for the knowledge of psychic potency, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

208. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cetopariyañāṇena nakāmāvacaracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… nakāmāvacarā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

208. A non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition—Nibbāna is a condition for the path, and for the fruit by way of object condition; one knows the mind of one endowed with non-sensuous-sphere consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge; the base of the infinity of space is a condition for the base of the infinity of consciousness... the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... the non-sensuous-sphere aggregates are conditions for the knowledge of psychic potency, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (1)

Nakāmāvacaro [M 4.0134] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti; phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ [T 4.0454] paccavekkhati, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ paccavekkhati, iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, nakāmāvacare khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A non-sensuous-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensuous-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition—having emerged from jhāna, one reviews, delights in, and rejoices in the jhāna; based on that, lust arises, wrong view arises... the noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path; they review the fruit... review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, and adverting consciousness by way of object condition; one reviews the base of infinite space, reviews the base of infinite consciousness, reviews the base of nothingness, reviews the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, reviews the divine eye, reviews the divine ear-element, reviews the knowledge of psychic powers, reviews mind-reading knowledge... reviews the knowledge of past lives... reviews the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings... reviews the knowledge of the future; regarding the non-sensuous-sphere aggregates as impermanent... grief arises. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition.

209. Kāmāvacaro [V 4.0158] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ kāmāvacare khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – kāmāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

209. A sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition: as object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: One esteems giving... virtue... Uposatha observance... or previously performed good deeds, and reflects upon, savors, and delights in them; esteeming that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Learners reflect upon change-of-lineage, esteeming it; they reflect upon purification, esteeming it. One esteems the eye... the base... or the sensual-sphere aggregates, and savors and delights in them; esteeming that, lust arises, wrong view arises. As conascence-dominance: A sensual-sphere dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

210. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – nakāmāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati[T 4.0455], sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati [M 4.0135] viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ…pe… dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ…pe… iddhividhañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nakāmāvacare khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nakāmāvacarādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa ca nakāmāvacarassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – nakāmāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

210. A non-sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition: as object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: Nibbāna is a condition for the path and for the fruit by way of dominance condition. As conascence-dominance: A non-sensual-sphere dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. A non-sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition: as object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: Having emerged from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna, esteeming it, savors it, and delights in it; esteeming that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path, esteeming it; they reflect upon the fruit... Nibbāna, esteeming it. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification by way of dominance condition. One reflects upon the base of infinite space, esteeming it... the base of infinite consciousness... the base of nothingness... the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, esteeming it. One reflects upon the divine eye... the divine ear-element... the knowledge of psychic powers... the knowledge of the future, esteeming it. One esteems the non-sensual-sphere aggregates, savors them, and delights in them; esteeming them, lust arises, wrong view arises. As conascence-dominance: A non-sensual-sphere dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. A non-sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a sensual-sphere phenomenon and a non-sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition. As conascence-dominance: A non-sensual-sphere dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity condition, etc.

211. Kāmāvacaro [V 4.0159] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kāmāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… āvajjanā kāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo.

211. A sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of proximity condition—preceding sensual-sphere aggregates are a proximity condition for subsequent sensual-sphere aggregates; conformity is a proximity condition for change-of-lineage… conformity for purification…; adverting is a proximity condition for sensual-sphere aggregates.

Kāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 4.0456] paccayo – kāmāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ nakāmāvacarassa upapatticittassa… āvajjanā nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; kāmāvacarā khandhā nakāmāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… catutthassa jhānassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā…pe… iddhividhañāṇassa…pe… cetopariyañāṇassa…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇassa…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of proximity condition—sensual-sphere death consciousness is a proximity condition for non-sensual-sphere rebirth consciousness…; adverting is a proximity condition for the non-sensual-sphere aggregates; sensual-sphere aggregates are a proximity condition for emergence from a non-sensual-sphere attainment; the preliminary work for the first jhāna is a proximity condition for the first jhāna… up to… the fourth jhāna… up to… the preliminary work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… up to… for the divine eye… up to… for the divine ear-element… up to… for the knowledge of psychic powers… up to… for the knowledge of penetrating the minds of others… up to… for the knowledge of recollection of past lives… up to… for the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions… up to… the preliminary work for the knowledge of the future is a proximity condition for the knowledge of the future; change-of-lineage is a proximity condition for the path… purification is a proximity condition for the path…; conformity is a proximity condition for fruition-attainment. (2)

212. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nakāmāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; maggo phalassa, phalaṃ phalassa, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [M 4.0136] – nakāmāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ kāmāvacarassa upapatticittassa, nakāmāvacaraṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, nakāmāvacarā khandhā kāmāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo…. (2)

212. A non-sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of proximity condition—preceding non-sensual-sphere aggregates are a proximity condition for subsequent non-sensual-sphere aggregates; the path is a proximity condition for the fruit; the fruit is a proximity condition for the fruit; for one emerging from cessation, fruition is a proximity condition; the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a proximity condition for fruition-attainment. A non-sensual-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sensual-sphere phenomenon by way of proximity condition—non-sensual-sphere death consciousness is a proximity condition for sensual-sphere rebirth consciousness; non-sensual-sphere life-continuum is a proximity condition for adverting; non-sensual-sphere aggregates are a proximity condition for emergence from a sensual-sphere attainment…. (2)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… satta… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta.

By way of contiguity condition… by way of conascence condition… seven… by way of mutuality condition… six… by way of support condition… seven.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive support condition

213. Kāmāvacaro [T 4.0457][V 4.0160] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kāmāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; kāmāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāmāvacarā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ kāmāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

213. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on sense-sphere faith, one gives alms… morality… observance of the Uposatha… one produces insight, indulges in conceit, adheres to wrong view; relying on sense-sphere morality… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… weather… food… lodging, one gives alms… produces insight, kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha; sense-sphere faith… lodging is a decisive support condition for sense-sphere faith… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain. (1)

Kāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kāmāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya nakāmāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; kāmāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya nakāmāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; kāmāvacarā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ nakāmāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo; paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa…pe… catutthassa jhānassa…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanassa…pe… paṭhamassa maggassa…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on sense-sphere faith, one generates non-sense-sphere jhāna, the path… higher knowledge… attainment; relying on sense-sphere morality… lodging, one generates non-sense-sphere jhāna, the path… higher knowledge… attainment; sense-sphere faith… lodging is a decisive support condition for non-sense-sphere faith… wisdom… the path, fruition-attainment; the preliminary work for the first jhāna is a decisive support condition for the first jhāna… up to… the fourth jhāna… up to… the base of infinite space… up to… the preliminary work for the first path… up to… the preliminary work for the fourth path is a decisive support condition for the fourth path. (2)

214. Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[T 4.0458], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nakāmāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; nakāmāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ [M 4.0137] …pe… paññaṃ upanissāya nakāmāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti…pe… maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; nakāmāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā nakāmāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo; paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa [V 4.0161]…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… dutiyo maggo tatiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

214. A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on non-sense-sphere faith, one produces jhāna, the path… higher knowledge… attainment; relying on non-sense-sphere morality… wisdom, one produces non-sense-sphere jhāna… the path… higher knowledge… attainment; non-sense-sphere faith… wisdom is a decisive support condition for non-sense-sphere faith… wisdom, the path, fruition-attainment; the first jhāna is a decisive support condition for the second jhāna… up to… the third jhāna is a decisive support condition for the fourth jhāna… up to… the base of infinite space is a decisive support condition for the base of infinite consciousness… up to… the base of nothingness is a decisive support condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception; the first path is a decisive support condition for the second path… up to… the second path is a decisive support condition for the third path… up to… the third path is a decisive support condition for the fourth path; the path is a decisive support condition for fruition-attainment. (1)

Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nakāmāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; nakāmāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; nakāmāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā kāmāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa [T 4.0459] dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya saṅkhāre aniccato…pe… vipassanti, maggo ariyānaṃ atthapaṭisambhidāya… dhammapaṭisambhidāya… niruttipaṭisambhidāya… paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāya… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on non-sense-sphere faith, one gives alms, observes morality… the Uposatha observance… produces insight, indulges in conceit, adheres to wrong view; relying on non-sense-sphere morality… wisdom, one gives alms, observes morality… the Uposatha observance… produces insight, indulges in conceit, adheres to wrong view; non-sense-sphere faith… wisdom is a decisive support condition for sense-sphere faith… wisdom, lust… longing, bodily pleasure, bodily pain; the noble ones, relying on the path, contemplate formations as impermanent, and so on; the path is a decisive support condition for the noble ones’ analytical knowledge of meaning… analytical knowledge of the Dhamma… analytical knowledge of language… analytical knowledge of ready wit… skill regarding possibilities and impossibilities; fruition-attainment is a decisive support condition for bodily pleasure. (2)

Purejātapaccayādi

Pre-nascence Condition, and so on.

215. Kāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa …pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu kāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. Kāmāvacaro dhammo [M 4.0138] nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

215. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye... (and so on)... sorrow arises regarding the base as impermanent... (and so on); the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... (and so on)... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness... (and so on). Base pre-nascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness... (and so on)... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness... (and so on)... the base is a condition for sense-sphere aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one sees a form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear-element. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for non-sense-sphere aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… dve… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A condition by way of post-nascence: two. A condition by way of repetition: three.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, and so on.

216. Kāmāvacaro [V 4.0162] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (saṃkhittaṃ).

216. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of the kamma condition: co-nascence, and different moments (in brief).

Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (saṃkhittaṃ). Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena [T 4.0460] paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (saṃkhittaṃ). Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa ca nakāmāvacarassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascence, and different moments (in brief). A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascence, and different moments (in brief). A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a sense-sphere phenomenon and a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascence, and different moments (in brief). (3)

Vipākapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… dve.

By result condition… four… by nutriment condition… four… by faculty condition… four… by jhāna condition… four… by path condition… four… by association condition… two.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

217. Kāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Kāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

217. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence (in brief): at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for non-sense-sphere aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the base is a condition for non-sense-sphere aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nakāmāvacarā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – nakāmāvacarā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascence: non-sense-sphere aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… Post-nascence: non-sense-sphere aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, etc.

218. Kāmāvacaro [M 4.0139][V 4.0163] dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Kāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ[T 4.0461], purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu nakāmāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ). (2)

218. A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief). A sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for non-sense-sphere aggregates by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: one sees a form with the divine eye… and so on… (similar to pre-nascence). (2)

Nakāmāvacaro dhammo nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (vippayuttasadisaṃ). Nakāmāvacaro dhammo kāmāvacarassa ca nakāmāvacarassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence (in brief). A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (similar to dissociation). A non-sense-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a sense-sphere phenomenon and a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition (similar to dependence). (3)

219. Kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā kāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – nakāmāvacarā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – nakāmāvacarā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nakāmāvacarā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā nakāmāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nakāmāvacaro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (2)

219. Sense-sphere and non-sense-sphere phenomena are a condition for a sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence: non-sense-sphere aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… Post-nascence: non-sense-sphere aggregates and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: non-sense-sphere aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Sense-sphere and non-sense-sphere phenomena are a condition for a non-sense-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one non-sense-sphere aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates and… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… By absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition. (2)

Sense-sphere phenomena and non-sense-sphere phenomena are a condition for sense-sphere phenomena by co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions. Sense-sphere phenomena and non-sense-sphere phenomena are a condition for non-sense-sphere phenomena by co-nascence and pre-nascence conditions. (2)

Nahetu-naārammaṇapaccayā

Not by Root Condition, Not by Object Condition

230. Narūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca narūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ narūpāvacaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā) vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate [M 4.0143] khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. 230. (up to non-percipient beings); dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Anulomaṃ.

Direct Order.

Narūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho narūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

A non-fine-material sphere phenomenon associated with a non-fine-material sphere phenomenon arises not by way of root condition (in brief).

Nahetuyā ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā dve, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ.

Not by root, one; not by dominance, two; not by pre-nascence, two; not by post-nascence, two; not by repetition, two; not by kamma, two; not by result, two; not by jhāna, one; not by path, one; not by dissociation, one.

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative.

6. Association Section

(Evaṃ itare dve gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāropi kātabbo.)

(Thus, the other two enumerations and the Association Section should also be done.)
