Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

245. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – rūpāvacarā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Rūpāvacarā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Rūpāvacarā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

245. A fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of root condition: fine-material sphere roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (The root passage should be supplied.) Fine-material sphere roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (The root passage should be supplied.) Fine-material sphere roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – narūpāvacarā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ [V 4.0175] khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A non-fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of root condition: non-fine-material sphere roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

246. Rūpāvacaro [M 4.0149] dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetopariyañāṇena rūpāvacaracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti[T 4.0473], rūpāvacarā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paccavekkhati…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ…pe… iddhividhañāṇaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, rūpāvacare khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

246. A fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of object condition: one knows the mind of a person endowed with fine-material sphere consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge; the fine-material sphere aggregates are a condition for knowledge of psychic powers, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. A fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of object condition: one reviews the first jhāna…pe… reviews the fourth jhāna, reviews the divine eye, reviews the divine ear element…pe… knowledge of psychic powers…pe… mind-penetrating knowledge…pe… knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings…pe… knowledge of the future; one regards the fine-material sphere aggregates as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises. (2)

247. Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ narūpāvacare khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

247. A non-fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of object condition: having given alms, observed virtue…pe… performed the Uposatha observance…pe… one reflects on past good deeds, savors them, and rejoices in them; taking that as object, lust…pe… sorrow arises. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect on the path, reflect on the fruit, reflect on Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, path consciousness, fruition consciousness, and advertence by way of object condition. The noble ones reflect on the abandoned defilements…pe… suppressed defilements…pe… previously…pe… the eye…pe… the base; they regard the non-fine-material sphere aggregates as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness…pe… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception…pe… the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. (1)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena narūpāvacaracittasamaṅgissa [T 4.0474] cittaṃ jānāti, narūpāvacarā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa[V 4.0176], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fine-material sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material sphere phenomenon by way of object condition: with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; with mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of a person endowed with non-fine-material sphere consciousness. The non-fine-material sphere aggregates are a condition for knowledge of psychic powers, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

248. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – rūpāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo[M 4.0150]. Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ…pe… dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ…pe… iddhividhañāṇaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, rūpāvacare khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – rūpāvacarādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa ca narūpāvacarassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – rūpāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

248. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: A fine-material-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition—Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: Having regarded the first jhāna as paramount, one reflects on it, savors it, and rejoices in it. Having regarded it as paramount, lust arises, wrong view arises…and so on…the fourth jhāna…and so on…the divine eye…and so on…the divine ear element…and so on…knowledge of psychic power…and so on…mind-penetrating knowledge…and so on…knowledge of recollection of past lives…and so on…knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma…and so on…knowledge of the future—having regarded these as paramount, one reflects on them, savors them, and rejoices in them. Having regarded them as paramount, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having regarded the fine-material-sphere aggregates as paramount, one savors them and rejoices in them. Having regarded them as paramount, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence Dominance: A fine-material-sphere dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a fine-material-sphere phenomenon and a not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: A fine-material-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (3)

249. Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe [T 4.0475] suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ narūpāvacare khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ garuṃ [V 4.0177] katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati – narūpāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

249. A not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition—Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: Having regarded past good deeds such as giving…and so on…morality…and so on…the Uposatha observance…and so on…as paramount, one reflects on them, savors them, and rejoices in them. Having regarded them as paramount, lust arises, wrong view arises. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect on the path, having regarded it as paramount…and so on…the fruit…and so on…Nibbāna, having regarded it as paramount. Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, path consciousness, and fruition consciousness by way of dominance condition. They regard the eye…and so on…the base, and the not-fine-material-sphere aggregates as paramount, savoring them and rejoicing in them. Having regarded them as paramount, lust arises, wrong view arises. They reflect on the base of infinite space, having regarded it as paramount…and so on…reflect on the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, having regarded it as paramount. Co-nascence Dominance: A not-fine-material-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediate Condition, etc.

250. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā rūpāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – rūpāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ narūpāvacarassa upapatticittassa [M 4.0151] anantarapaccayena paccayo; rūpāvacaraṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… rūpāvacarā khandhā narūpāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

250. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the preceding fine-material-sphere aggregates are a condition for the succeeding fine-material-sphere aggregates by way of immediate condition. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the fine-material-sphere death consciousness is a condition for the not-fine-material-sphere rebirth consciousness by way of immediate condition; the fine-material-sphere life-continuum is a condition for adverting… the fine-material-sphere aggregates are a condition for the not-fine-material-sphere emergence by way of immediate condition. (2)

251. Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā narūpāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ narūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena [T 4.0476] paccayo. Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – narūpāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ rūpāvacarassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; narūpāvacarā khandhā rūpāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… catutthassa jhānassa…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā…pe… iddhividhañāṇassa…pe… cetopariyañāṇassa…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇassa…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa, parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

251. A not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the preceding not-fine-material-sphere aggregates are a condition for the succeeding not-fine-material-sphere aggregates by way of immediate condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage…and so on… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of immediate condition. A not-fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the not-fine-material-sphere death consciousness is a condition for the fine-material-sphere rebirth consciousness by way of immediate condition; the not-fine-material-sphere aggregates are a condition for the fine-material-sphere emergence by way of immediate condition; the preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition for the first jhāna by way of immediate condition…and so on… the fourth jhāna…and so on… the divine eye…and so on… the divine ear element…and so on… the knowledge of psychic power…and so on… mind-penetrating knowledge…and so on… the knowledge of recollection of past lives…and so on… the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma…and so on… the knowledge of the future; the preliminary work for the knowledge of the future is a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of immediate condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… satta… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta.

By way of contiguity condition… by way of co-nascence condition… seven… by way of mutuality condition… six… by way of support condition… seven.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

252. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya rūpāvacaraṃ [V 4.0178] jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; rūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya rūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; rūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā rūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyassa jhānassa…pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ catutthassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

252. A fine-material-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a fine-material-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—proximity decisive support, natural decisive support…and so on…. Natural decisive support: Relying on fine-material-sphere faith, one produces fine-material-sphere jhāna, higher knowledge…and so on… or attainment; relying on fine-material-sphere virtue…and so on… or wisdom, one produces fine-material-sphere jhāna…and so on… higher knowledge…and so on… or attainment. Fine-material-sphere faith…and so on… or wisdom is a condition for fine-material-sphere faith…and so on… or wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The first jhāna is a condition for the second jhāna by way of decisive support condition; the second jhāna for the third jhāna…and so on… the third jhāna for the fourth jhāna by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Rūpāvacaro [T 4.0477] dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ [M 4.0152] karoti; rūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ…pe… maggaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; rūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; rūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā narūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: Relying on form-sphere faith, one gives a gift, observes virtue…pe… performs the Uposatha observance; one produces form-sphere jhāna…pe… insight…pe… the path…pe… attainment, generates conceit, or grasps wrong view; relying on form-sphere virtue…pe… wisdom, one gives a gift…pe… generates conceit, or grasps wrong view; form-sphere faith…pe… wisdom is a condition for non-form-sphere faith…pe… wisdom… lust…pe… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… the path, or fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. (2)

253. Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – narūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ karoti; narūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ…pe… maggaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; narūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… bhojanaṃ, senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; narūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā… rāgo…pe… senāsanaṃ narūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

253. A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: Relying on non-form-sphere faith, one gives a gift…pe… observes virtue…pe… performs the Uposatha observance; one produces non-form-sphere jhāna…pe… insight…pe… the path…pe… attainment, generates conceit, or grasps wrong view; relying on non-form-sphere virtue…pe… wisdom, lust…pe… food, or lodging, one gives a gift…pe… kills a living being…pe… causes a schism in the Saṅgha. Non-form-sphere faith…pe… wisdom… lust…pe… lodging is a condition for non-form-sphere faith…pe… wisdom… lust…pe… longing, for bodily pleasure…pe… bodily pain… the path, or fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – narūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya rūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ [T 4.0478] …pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; narūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ [V 4.0179] upanissāya rūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; narūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo, paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… catutthassa jhānassa…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā…pe… iddhividhañāṇassa…pe… cetopariyañāṇassa…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇassa…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—proximity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: Relying on non-form-sphere faith, one produces form-sphere jhāna…pe… higher knowledge…pe… or attainment; relying on non-form-sphere virtue…pe… or lodging, one produces form-sphere jhāna…pe… higher knowledge…pe… or attainment; non-form-sphere faith…pe… or lodging is a condition for form-sphere faith…pe… or wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition for the first jhāna by way of decisive support condition…pe… for the fourth jhāna…pe… the preliminary work for the divine eye…pe… for the divine ear-element…pe… for the knowledge of psychic powers…pe… for the knowledge of others' minds…pe… for the knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma…pe… the preliminary work for the knowledge of the future is a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayādi

Pre-nascence Condition, etc.

254. Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ [M 4.0153] …pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo; vatthu narūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

254. A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: considering the eye…pe… the physical basis as impermanent…pe… grief arises; the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition; the physical basis is a condition for the non-form-sphere aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one sees a form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear-element. Base pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for the form-sphere aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… dve… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

By way of post-nascence condition… (2) …By way of repetition condition… (3).

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, etc.

255. Rūpāvacaro [T 4.0479] dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – rūpāvacarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – rūpāvacarā cetanā vipākānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – rūpāvacarā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena [V 4.0180] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – rūpāvacarā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa ca narūpāvacarassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – rūpāvacarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – rūpāvacarā cetanā vipākānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

255. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, different-moment. Co-nascent: form-sphere volition is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of kamma condition; at the moment of relinking…pe…. Different-moment: form-sphere volition is a condition for the resultant form-sphere aggregates by way of kamma condition. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, different-moment. Co-nascent: form-sphere volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of relinking…pe…. Different-moment: form-sphere volition is a condition for kamma-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a form-sphere and a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, different-moment. Co-nascent: form-sphere volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of relinking…pe…. Different-moment: form-sphere volition is a condition for the resultant form-sphere aggregates and for kamma-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – narūpāvacarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – narūpāvacarā cetanā vipākānaṃ narūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo…. (1)

A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Kamma Condition—co-nascent, at a different moment. Co-nascent: non-form-sphere volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of Kamma Condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on…. At a different moment: non-form-sphere volition is a condition for the resultant non-form-sphere aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of Kamma Condition…. (1)

Vipākapaccayena [M 4.0154] paccayo… cattāri… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena [T 4.0480] paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… dve.

By way of Result Condition… four… By way of Nutriment Condition… four… By way of Faculty Condition… four… By way of Jhāna Condition… four… By way of Path Condition… four… By way of Association Condition… two.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

256. Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

256. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Dissociation Condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Dissociation Condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of Dissociation Condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: at the moment of relinking, the base is a condition for the form-sphere aggregates by way of Dissociation Condition. Pre-nascent: the base is a condition for the form-sphere aggregates by way of Dissociation Condition. (2)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, etc.

257. Rūpāvacaro [V 4.0181] dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). Rūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Rūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa ca narūpāvacarassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

257. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition (similar to dependent origination). A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent. A form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both form-sphere and non-form-sphere phenomena by way of Presence Condition (similar to dependent origination). (3)

Narūpāvacaro dhammo narūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Narūpāvacaro dhammo rūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, vatthu rūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty (in brief). A non-form-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: at the moment of relinking, the base is a condition for the form-sphere aggregates by way of Presence Condition. Pre-nascent: one sees a form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear-element; the base is a condition for the form-sphere aggregates by way of Presence Condition. (2)

258. Rūpāvacaro ca narūpāvacaro ca dhammā rūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ[T 4.0481], purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – rūpāvacaro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Rūpāvacaro ca narūpāvacaro ca dhammā narūpāvacarassa [M 4.0155] dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – rūpāvacarā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – rūpāvacarā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – rūpāvacarā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

258. Form-sphere and non-form-sphere phenomena are conditions for a form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: one form-sphere aggregate and the base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of Presence Condition… and so on… two aggregates and… and so on… at the moment of relinking… and so on…. Form-sphere and non-form-sphere phenomena are conditions for a non-form-sphere phenomenon by way of Presence Condition: co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: the form-sphere aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of Presence Condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on…. Post-nascent: the form-sphere aggregates and physical nutriment are conditions for this pre-nascent body by way of Presence Condition. Post-nascent: the form-sphere aggregates and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-produced materiality by way of Presence Condition. (2)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, arūpāvacare [T 4.0491] khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – arūpāvacarādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Arūpāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

281. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by dominance condition. Conascence-Dominance: A formless-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates by dominance condition. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by dominance condition—Object-Dominance and Conascence-Dominance. Object-Dominance: Having given great importance to the base of infinite space, one reviews it…pe… having given great importance to the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, one reviews it; having given great importance to the formless-sphere aggregates, one savors and delights in them; having given great importance to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-Dominance: A formless-sphere dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated matter by dominance condition. (The root should be done.) A formless-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by dominance condition. (3)

282. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ naarūpāvacare khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – naarūpāvacarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

282. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object dominance, conascence dominance. Object dominance: having performed generosity…pe… morality…pe… the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, relishes it, and rejoices in it, having made it important; having made that important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Previously well-performed deeds…pe… jhānas…pe… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, having made it important; they review the fruit…pe… Nibbāna, having made it important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, and the fruit by way of dominance condition. One relishes and rejoices in the eye…pe… the physical basis and the non-formless-sphere aggregates, having made them important; having made that important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence dominance: a non-formless-sphere dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

283. Arūpāvacaro [M 4.0164] dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā [V 4.0193] purimā arūpāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – arūpāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ naarūpāvacarassa upapatticittassa, arūpāvacaraṃ bhavaṅgaṃ [T 4.0492] āvajjanāya, arūpāvacarā khandhā naarūpāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

283. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of contiguity condition—the preceding formless-sphere aggregates are a condition for the subsequent formless-sphere aggregates by way of contiguity condition. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of contiguity condition—the formless-sphere death-consciousness is a condition for the non-formless-sphere rebirth-consciousness; the formless-sphere life-continuum is a condition for adverting; the formless-sphere aggregates are a condition for emergence into the non-formless sphere; for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of contiguity condition. (2)

284. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā naarūpāvacarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naarūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – naarūpāvacaraṃ cuticittaṃ arūpāvacarassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; naarūpāvacarā khandhā arūpāvacarassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

284. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of contiguity condition—the preceding non-formless-sphere aggregates are a condition for the subsequent non-formless-sphere aggregates by way of contiguity condition; conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage…pe… conformity is a condition for fruition attainment by way of contiguity condition. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of contiguity condition—the non-formless-sphere death-consciousness is a condition for the formless-sphere rebirth-consciousness by way of contiguity condition; the non-formless-sphere aggregates are a condition for emergence into the formless sphere by way of contiguity condition; the preparatory consciousness for the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite space by way of contiguity condition; the preparatory consciousness for the base of infinite consciousness…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the base of nothingness…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pañca… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… dve… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta.

Immediacy Condition… Conascence Condition… five… Mutuality Condition… two… Dependence Condition… seven.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

285. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ [T 4.0493] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo [M 4.0165] – arūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ karoti[V 4.0194], naarūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; arūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… mānaṃ jappeti… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; arūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… paññā naarūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

285. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness by way of decisive support condition; the base of infinite consciousness is a condition for the base of nothingness…pe… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception by way of decisive support condition. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: having formless-sphere faith as decisive support, one gives gifts, observes moral precepts…pe… performs the Uposatha observance, arouses non-formless-sphere jhāna, insight…pe… the path…pe… higher knowledge…pe… attainments, indulges in conceit, adopts a wrong view; having formless-sphere virtue…pe… wisdom as decisive support, one gives gifts…pe… arouses attainments… indulges in conceit… adopts a wrong view; formless-sphere faith…pe… wisdom is a condition for non-formless-sphere faith…pe… wisdom… for lust…pe… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for the path, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (2)

286. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – naarūpāvacaraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ karoti, naarūpāvacaraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; naarūpāvacaraṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ…pe… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; naarūpāvacarā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ naarūpāvacarāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā [T 4.0494] upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

286. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: having non-formless-sphere faith as decisive support, one gives gifts, observes moral precepts…pe… performs the Uposatha observance, arouses non-formless-sphere jhāna, insight…pe… the path…pe… higher knowledge…pe… attainments, indulges in conceit… adopts a wrong view; having non-formless-sphere virtue…pe… wisdom…pe… lust…pe… aspiration…pe… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging as decisive support, one gives gifts…pe… arouses attainments… kills a living being…pe… creates a schism in the Saṅgha; non-formless-sphere faith…pe… lodging is a condition for non-formless-sphere faith…pe… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain, for the path, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Naarūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—immediate decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: the preparatory consciousness for the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite space by way of decisive support condition…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayādi

Pre-nascence Condition, and so on.

287. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ [M 4.0166][V 4.0195] cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu naarūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu arūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

287. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye…pe… the base when seen as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds, the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe…. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the non-formless-sphere aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the formless-sphere aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… dve… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

By way of post-nascence condition… two… by way of repetition condition… three.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

288. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā…pe…. Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – arūpāvacarā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo[T 4.0495]. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) Arūpāvacarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

288. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascence, non-simultaneous…pe…. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition: formless-sphere volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (The root should be done.) Formless-sphere volition is a condition for associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – naarūpāvacarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascence, non-simultaneous. Co-nascence: non-formless-sphere volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition (briefly). (1)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, and so on.

289. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

289. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of result condition (briefly).

Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ)… āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… dve.

A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of result condition (briefly)… by way of nutriment condition… four… by way of faculty condition… four… by way of jhāna condition… four… by way of path condition… four… by way of association condition… two.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

290. Arūpāvacaro [V 4.0196] dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

290. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascence, post-nascence (briefly). (1)

Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Naarūpāvacaro dhammo [M 4.0167] arūpāvacarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu arūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence (briefly). A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the formless-sphere aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, and so on.

291. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ…pe…. Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ[T 4.0496], pacchājātaṃ…pe…. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa ca naarūpāvacarassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

291. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence…pe…. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence, post-nascence…pe…. A formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for both a formless-sphere and a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence (briefly). (3)

Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Naarūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu arūpāvacarānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (briefly). A non-formless-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the formless-sphere aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

292. Arūpāvacaro ca naarūpāvacaro ca dhammā arūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – arūpāvacaro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Arūpāvacaro ca naarūpāvacaro ca dhammā naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – arūpāvacarā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – arūpāvacarā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro [V 4.0197] āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – arūpāvacarā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

292. Both formless-sphere and non-formless-sphere phenomena are conditions for a formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one formless-sphere aggregate and the base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates and…pe…. Both formless-sphere and non-formless-sphere phenomena are conditions for a non-formless-sphere phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascence: the formless-sphere aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the formless-sphere aggregates and physical nutriment are conditions for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the formless-sphere aggregates and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-generated materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conditional Relations in Forward Order

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

293. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye satta, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, pacchājāte dve, āsevane tīṇi, kamme cattāri, vipāke dve, āhāre cattāri, indriye [M 4.0168] cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri[T 4.0497], sampayutte dve, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate satta.

293. By root condition, four; by object condition, three; by dominance condition, four; by contiguity condition, four; by immediate contiguity condition, four; by co-nascence condition, five; by reciprocity condition, two; by dependence condition, seven; by strong dependence condition, four; by pre-nascence condition, two; by post-nascence condition, two; by repetition condition, three; by kamma condition, four; by result condition, two; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by jhāna condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, two; by dissociation condition, three; by presence condition, seven; by absence condition, four; by disappearance condition, four; by non-disappearance condition, seven.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Summary of the Negative

294. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Arūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa ca naarūpāvacarassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

294. An immaterial-sphere phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of strong dependence condition. An immaterial-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of strong dependence condition… by way of post-nascence condition. An immaterial-sphere phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial-sphere phenomenon and a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (3)

295. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. Naarūpāvacaro dhammo arūpāvacarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

295. A non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon is a condition for a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of strong dependence condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. A non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of strong dependence condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Arūpāvacaro [V 4.0198] ca naarūpāvacaro ca dhammā arūpāvacarassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Arūpāvacaro ca naarūpāvacaro ca dhammā naarūpāvacarassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

An immaterial-sphere phenomenon and a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon are conditions for an immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. An immaterial-sphere phenomenon and a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon are conditions for a non-immaterial-sphere phenomenon by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (2)
