31. Savitakko akusalo dhammo savitakkassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

31. An unwholesome state with applied thought is a condition for an unwholesome state with applied thought by way of root condition. (In brief.)

32. Hetuyā [T 5.0299] tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava…pe… sahajāte pañca…pe… upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi…pe… jhāne pañca, magge pañca, sampayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā nava…pe… avigate pañca (saṃkhittaṃ).

By root condition, three; in object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; in contiguity condition, nine; … in co-nascence condition, five; … in support condition, nine; in repetition condition, nine; in kamma condition, three; in nutriment condition, three; … in jhāna condition, five; in path condition, five; in association condition, five; by presence condition, five; by absence condition, nine; … in non-disappearance condition, five. By root condition, four; in object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine (nine throughout); in decisive support condition, nine; in prenascence condition, three; in postnascence condition, three; in repetition condition, nine; in kamma condition, four; in resultant condition, nine; in nutriment condition, four; … in jhāna condition, nine; in path condition, nine; in conjoined condition, six; in disjoined condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; in disappearance condition, nine; in non-disappearance condition, nine. Avitakkaavicāraṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (tīṇi). 93. By root condition, thirty-seven; by object condition, twenty-one; by dominance condition, twenty-three; by contiguity condition, twenty-one; by co-nascence condition, thirty-seven; by reciprocity condition, twenty-eight; by support condition, thirty-seven; by strong dependence condition, twenty-one; by pre-nascence condition, eleven; by repetition condition, eleven; by kamma condition, thirty-seven; by result, nutriment, faculty, jhāna, and path conditions, thirty-seven; by association condition, twenty-one; by dissociation condition, thirty-seven; …pe… by non-disappearance condition, thirty-seven. Nahetuyā tettiṃsa, naārammaṇe satta (saṃkhittaṃ).

Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta (saṃkhittaṃ).

In root condition, by non-object condition, seven. (In brief).

Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe cuddasa (saṃkhittaṃ).

205. Uppanno [V 4.0665] hetu dhammo uppannassa hetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – uppannā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

205. An arisen root-state is a condition for an arisen root-state by way of root condition—arisen roots are a condition for associated roots by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Anuppanno hetu dhammo uppannassa hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – anuppannā hetū cetopariyañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Uppādī hetu dhammo uppannassa hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – uppādī hetū cetopariyañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unarisen root-state is a condition for an arisen root-state by way of object condition—unarisen roots are a condition for the knowledge of others’ minds and for the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. An arising root-state is a condition for an arisen root-state by way of object condition—arising roots are a condition for the knowledge of others’ minds and for the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

Uppanno [M 4.0541] hetu dhammo uppannassa hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena [T 5.0420] paccayo… tīṇi.

An arisen root-state is a condition for an arisen root-state by way of predominance condition… three.

Sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… vipākapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

…is a condition by way of conascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma-result condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of presence condition… and so on … by way of non-disappearance condition.

206. Hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā tīṇi, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye dve…pe… avigate ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

206. In root condition, one; in object condition, two; in predominance condition, three; in conascence condition, one; in mutuality condition, one; in support condition, one; in decisive support condition, two… and so on … in non-disappearance condition, one (in brief).

Nahetuyā dve, naārammaṇe dve (saṃkhittaṃ).

In non-root condition, two; in non-object condition, two (in brief).

Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

By root condition, in non-object condition, one (in brief).

Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe dve (saṃkhittaṃ).

By non-root condition, in object condition, two (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike pañhāvāraṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

A root phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a root phenomenon with a present object by way of root condition. (1)
